senses: vt. (从四面八方)围住,包围,圈(公地)为私有
vt. 围住，包住；把…装入信封，附入
enclose.usage: 助记:en(动词前缀,使……)+close(关闭)→关在里面→围住；索引p407

ex.en: Please enclose a copy of your certificate with the application form.
ex.zh: 请随申请表附上一份证书复印件。

senses: n. 圈用地，围场；（信中）附件

ex.en: The letter contained an enclosure listing all the documents required for the interview.
ex.zh: 信中有一份附件，列出了面试所需的全部文件。

ex.en: Girls' attraction to pink may seem unavoidable, somehow encoded in their DNA, but according to Jo Paoletti, an associate professor of American Studies, it is not.
ex.zh: 女孩似乎不可避免地被粉红色吸引，这一特质在某种程度上与生俱来，不过美国研究学院的副教授乔·保莱蒂却不这么认为。

senses: vt. 包含，包括，涉及（大量事物）；包围；围绕；围住

ex.en: The new regulations encompass every stage of food production, from farm to shop.
ex.zh: 新法规涵盖了从农场到商店的食品生产每一个环节。

encounter.usage: [近]meet vt. 遇见；同义 confront；meet；v.遭遇；偶遇 n.偶遇；经历；冲突；使(en)进入相对(counter)状况，那不就是俩人遇上了吗→遇见，遭遇；词根:en(enter进入)+counter(against反对)→进去就遭到反对→遭遇;易混词辨析:encounter通常指遇到困难或挫折,

ex.en: I had never encountered such resistance before.
ex.zh: 我以前从未遇到过这么大的阻力。

ex.en: Like other human beings, he encounters moral issues even in the everyday performance of his routine duties.
ex.zh: 和其他人一样，既使他（指科学家）在履行日常职责时也会遇到道德方面的问题。

ex.en: Visitors to the remote island may encounter rare birds found nowhere else on Earth.
ex.zh: 到这个偏远岛屿的游客可能会遇到地球上其他地方没有的珍稀鸟类。

encourage.usage: en-（使）+ courage（勇气）→使有勇气→鼓励；派生 encouragement n. 鼓励，促进；v.鼓励，激励；刺激，促进；en(使)+courage(勇气)→使你有勇气→激励，鼓励；派生encouragement n.鼓励；词根记忆：en(使)+cour(heart,心)+age(名词后缀)→用心鼓励他人

ex.en: Alongside that, many countries are introducing English into the primary-school curriculum but British schoolchildren and students do not appear to be gaining greater encouragement to achieve fluency in other languages.
ex.zh: 此外，很多国家正在将英语列入小学课程范围，但是英国学童和学生似乎没有受到更多的鼓励去学习从而流利地使用其他语言。

ex.en: If you have no friends or relatives, try to participate in several online communities, full of people who are always willing to share advice and encouragement.
ex.zh: 如果你没有朋友或亲戚，试着参加几个在线社区，那里到处都是愿意分享建议和提供鼓励的人。

ex.en: This would boost incomes, encourage work, reward companies for job creation, and reduce inequality.
ex.zh: 这样做可以增加收入，刺激就业，奖励创造就业机会的企业，而且还可以减少不公平。

senses: n. 鼓励，鼓舞；起激励作用的事物

ex.en: Her teacher's encouragement gave her the confidence to apply for the scholarship.
ex.zh: 老师的鼓励给了她申请奖学金的信心。

ex.en: Government subsidies offer encouragement to firms that invest in renewable energy.
ex.zh: 政府补贴为投资可再生能源的公司提供了激励。

ex.en: With constant encouragement from his parents, he eventually overcame his fear of public speaking.
ex.zh: 在父母的不断鼓励下，他最终克服了对公开演讲的恐惧。

ex.en: The suffix '-ency' forms nouns of state or quality, such as 'efficiency' and 'urgency'.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ency 构成表状态或性质的名词，如 efficiency（效率）、urgency（紧迫性）。

ex.en: Before the internet, households relied on an encyclopaedia for basic facts and figures.
ex.zh: 在互联网出现之前，家庭要查基本的事实和数据都依靠百科全书。

ex.en: The online encyclopedia allows any user to edit most of its entries.
ex.zh: 这部在线百科全书允许任何用户编辑其中的大部分词条。

phrases.p: reach the end of the line

end.usage: end up doing sth.最终做某事；另 on end 竖起，直立着；make ends meet 量入为出；end sth. off/up 结束；end to end 首尾相连地；小记：by the end of 到…时为止；at the end of 在…结束时；索引p407

ex.en: His analysis should therefore end any self-contentedness among those who may believe that the global position of English is so stable that the young generations of the United Kingdom do not need additional language capabilities.
ex.zh: 因此，对于那些可能会相信英语的全球地位如此稳固、以至于英国的年轻人无需额外语言能力的人而言，他的分析应该能够终结他们的任何自满。

ex.en: The company decided to end its sponsorship of the event after the scandal.
ex.zh: 丑闻发生后，该公司决定终止对这项赛事的赞助。

ex.en: By the end of the decade, solar power could be cheaper than coal.
ex.zh: 到这个十年结束时，太阳能发电可能比煤炭更便宜。

ex.en: The new regulations put an end to the practice of charging hidden fees.
ex.zh: 新规定杜绝了收取隐性费用的做法。

senses: v. 使遭遇危险;危及;危害

ex.en: Conservationists warn that illegal logging continues to endanger rare species in the rainforest.
ex.zh: 自然保护主义者警告说，非法采伐继续危及雨林中的珍稀物种。

ex.en: The wetland provides a vital habitat for several endangered species of birds.
ex.zh: 这片湿地为若干濒危鸟类提供了重要的栖息地。

ex.en: Despite every endeavor, the engineers could not repair the undersea cable before winter.
ex.zh: 尽管竭尽全力，工程师们仍未能赶在入冬前修复海底电缆。

endeavour.usage: 发音类似"赢得我"→要想赢得我就得"努力"，要竭尽全力→努力；索引p407

ex.en: Please make every endeavour to arrive on time.
ex.zh: 请尽全力按时到达。

ex.en: California's Forest Carbon Plan endeavors to reduce the density of some of its forests.
ex.zh: 加利福尼亚州的“森林碳计划”致力于降低其部分林区的密度。

ex.en: Scientific endeavour often requires years of patient work before any breakthrough appears.
ex.zh: 科学探索往往需要多年耐心的工作，才会有所突破。

ex.en: The government promised to support every endeavour aimed at reducing youth unemployment.
ex.zh: 政府承诺支持一切旨在降低青年失业率的努力。

endeavourendeavor.usage: 辨析：endeavour 正式用语，指为目标而做的一切努力(后接 to)；try 常用词，试图、尽力、设法；attempt 较正式，后常与 to 连用

ex.en: The charity endeavours to reach every village cut off by the floods within two days.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构努力在两天内抵达每一个被洪水隔断的村庄。

ex.en: The film's unexpected ending left the audience debating its meaning for days.
ex.zh: 影片出人意料的结局让观众好几天都在讨论它的含义。

phrases.m: 一种无休止的自我庆贺的狂热

endless.usage: 词根记忆：end(结束)+less(否定后缀)→不能结束的→无止境的；索引p407

ex.en: Endless meetings consume time that employees could otherwise spend on real work.
ex.zh: 没完没了的会议占用了员工本可用于实际工作的时间。

ex.en: The committee debated endlessly over the exact wording of the final recommendation.
ex.zh: 委员会就最终建议的确切措辞无休止地争论。

senses: v. ①(公开)赞同，支持，认可
②(在支票背面)签名；(在驾驶证上)记录违章事项

ex.en: Several famous athletes endorse sports drinks, though they rarely drink them themselves.
ex.zh: 几位著名运动员为运动饮料代言，尽管他们自己很少喝。

ex.en: The committee refused to endorse the plan without further evidence of its benefits.
ex.zh: 委员会拒绝在没有进一步证明该计划好处的情况下表示支持。

ex.en: Leading doctors endorsed the new vaccine after reviewing the clinical trial data.
ex.zh: 顶级医生们在审阅临床试验数据后认可了这种新疫苗。

senses: vt. 使某人天生具有(好的品质或能力)
endow.usage: en-(加强)+dow(给)→不断给予→资助/赋予；[族] endowment n. 天赋；资助

ex.en: Nature has endowed the region with rich soil and a mild climate.
ex.zh: 大自然赋予了这个地区肥沃的土壤和温和的气候。

ex.en: The university's endowment funds scholarships for students from low-income families.
ex.zh: 这所大学的捐赠基金为来自低收入家庭的学生提供奖学金。

senses: n. 忍耐(力),持久(力),耐久(性)
endurance.usage: 记：en-（加强意义）+dur（持久）+-ance（名词后缀）→持久力→耐久力；n.耐力，忍耐力；索引p407

ex.en: Marathon running tests both physical endurance and mental strength.
ex.zh: 马拉松赛跑考验的既是体力耐力，也是精神力量。

ex.en: The endurance of the bridge was proved in several severe earthquakes.
ex.zh: 这座桥的耐久性已在几次强震中得到验证。

ex.en: Survivors showed extraordinary endurance in the freezing mountain conditions.
ex.zh: 幸存者在严寒的山地条件下表现出非凡的忍耐力。

senses: v. 忍受，忍耐；持久，持续
endure.usage: end（最后）+ure→一直坚持到最后→忍耐，忍受；索引p407

ex.en: Equally, there is a sense that the travails of commuters in the South East, many of whom will face among the biggest rises, have received too much attention compared to those who must endure the relatively poor infrastructure of the Midlands and the North.
ex.zh: 此外，与中部、北部地区不得不忍受相对落后的基础设施的通勤者相比，东南部地区通勤者的出行困境（其中许多人将面临最大的票价涨幅）受到了过多关注。

ex.en: The fossil record shows that many species have endured for millions of years—so why shouldn't we?
ex.zh: 化石记录表明许多物种都持续生存了数百万年——那为什么我们不可以呢？

ex.en: The early settlers had to endure extreme cold and food shortages during their first winter.
ex.zh: 早期移民在第一个冬天不得不忍受极度的寒冷和食物短缺。

senses: n. [C] 敌人；反对者；危害物

ex.en: In public health campaigns, misinformation is often the greatest enemy of progress.
ex.zh: 在公共卫生宣传中，错误信息往往是进步的最大敌人。

senses: a. 精力充沛的；充满活力的
adj. 有力的，精力旺盛的
adj. 精力充沛的，充满活力的，积极的
energetic.usage: [族]energy n. 精力；energ(联想energy能量活力)+et+ic(形容词后缀)→精力充沛的；索引p407

ex.en: They are energetic participants in a global economy driven by the flow of work, money, and ideas.
ex.zh: 受工作、资金和观念潮流的驱使，他们成为全球经济的积极参与者。

ex.en: An energetic campaign by local volunteers raised record sums for the charity.
ex.zh: 当地志愿者开展的一场声势浩大的运动为慈善机构募集到创纪录的款项。

ex.en: The new manager is young and energetic, and quickly won the team's trust.
ex.zh: 新经理年轻而富有活力，很快赢得了团队的信任。

senses: （亦作energize）vt. 使精力充沛；为……提供电力（或能量）；使通电

ex.en: A short walk at lunchtime can energise you for the rest of the working day.
ex.zh: 午餐时散一小段步，能让你在剩下的工作时间里精力充沛。

energy.usage: 同义 strength, vigor, vitality；power；真题搭配：efficient energy 高效能源；索引p407

ex.en: Wind and solar energy are becoming increasingly competitive with fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 风能和太阳能与化石燃料相比正变得越来越有竞争力。

ex.en: She devoted so much energy to her career that she had little time for family.
ex.zh: 她在事业上投入了太多精力，几乎没时间陪伴家人。

ex.en: The government plans to invest heavily in clean energy over the next decade.
ex.zh: 政府计划在未来十年大力投资清洁能源。

senses: vt. ①(on, upon) 强迫，强加
v. 强制执行；强行实施；强迫，迫使
enforce.usage: [族] enforcement n. 执行；同义 compel, force；enhance, intensify；派生 enforcement n. 实施，执行；强迫；加强；v.强制实施；强迫，迫使；en（使）+force（力量）→用力量使你去做→强迫；词根记忆：en(make,使)+forc(strong,强壮的)

ex.en: In Arizona v. United States, the majority overturned three of the four contested provisions of Arizona's controversial plan to have state and local police enforce federal immigration law.
ex.zh: 在亚利桑那州与联邦政府一案中，多数法官推翻了颇具争议的亚利桑那州移民方案（让州和地方警察执行联邦移民法）中四项受质疑条款里的三项。

ex.en: The bans, if fully enforced, would suggest to women (and many men) that they should not let others be arbiters of their beauty.
ex.zh: 这些禁令如果得到全面执行，将会向女性（和很多男性）表明，他们不应该让别人来评判自己的美。

ex.en: The government must enforce the new traffic laws strictly to reduce road accidents.
ex.zh: 政府必须严格执行新交通法规，以减少道路事故。

enforcement.usage: n.（强制）执行，实施；另：federal-state immigration enforcement 联邦政府和州政府联合执行移民法；索引p407

ex.en: Effective enforcement of traffic laws is essential to reducing road accidents.
ex.zh: 有效执行交通法规对减少道路事故至关重要。

senses: vt. 吸引住（注意力、兴趣）
engage.usage: 族：engagement n. 订婚；约定；雇聘。近义：participate v. 参与；engage in（使）从事……；同义 hire, employ；派生 engaging adj. 吸引注意力的，迷人的；v.雇用；参加，从事；吸引， 引起；索引p407

ex.en: "There is one and only one social responsibility of businesses," Wrote Milton Friedman, a Nobel prize-winning economist, "That is, to use its resources and engage in activities designed to increase its profits."
ex.zh: 诺贝尔经济学奖获得者米尔顿·弗里德曼曾写道，"企业有且只有一种责任，即为增加利润而运用资源，开展活动。"

ex.en: Rats have been shown to engage in multiple forms of reciprocal help and cooperation.
ex.zh: 老鼠已经被证明会进行多种形式的互惠帮助和合作。

ex.en: Nevertheless, Williams's suit charges that the casino, knowing he was "helplessly addicted to gambling," intentionally worked to "lure" him to "engage in conduct against his will."
ex.zh: 尽管如此，威廉姆斯还是提起了诉讼，控告赌场明知其“深染赌瘾”，却还故意“引诱”他“参与违背自己意愿的事情”。

senses: n. 参与；婚约；约定；交战

ex.en: The announcement of their engagement appeared in the local newspaper.
ex.zh: 他们订婚的消息登在了当地报纸上。

ex.en: Because of a previous engagement, the professor could not attend the seminar.
ex.zh: 由于有约在先，教授未能出席那次研讨会。

ex.en: Employee engagement rises sharply when workers feel their opinions are valued.
ex.zh: 当员工感到自己的意见受到重视时，其工作投入度会大幅上升。

ex.en: The lecturer's engaging style kept even the sleepiest students attentive.
ex.zh: 这位讲师引人入胜的讲课风格让连最困的学生都听得聚精会神。

ex.en: Critics warned that the new policy could engender resentment among those who felt excluded from the decision-making process.
ex.zh: 批评者警告说，这项新政策可能会在被排除在决策过程之外的人群中引起不满。

senses: n. 发动机；火车头；机车
n. 发动机,引擎;火车头

ex.en: The new engine design cuts fuel consumption by nearly twenty percent.
ex.zh: 新的发动机设计将燃油消耗降低了近百分之二十。

senses: vt. 策划；改变…的基因(或遗传)结构；设计制造
engineer.usage: 助记:engine(发动机)+er(名词后缀表示人)→工程师；索引p407

ex.en: And that's the problem with a social cure engineered from the outside: in the real world, as in school, we insist on choosing our own friends.
ex.zh: 这也是外部策划的社会救治的问题所在：在现实的社会中，就和在学校一样，我们都坚持自己选择朋友。

ex.en: Humanity has the necessary agrotechnological tools to eradicate hunger, from genetically engineered crops to artificial fertilizers.
ex.zh: 从转基因作物到化肥，人类有消除饥饿的必要农业技术工具。

ex.en: The software engineer designed an app that helps blind users navigate city streets.
ex.zh: 这位软件工程师设计了一款帮助盲人在城市街道上导航的应用程序。

ex.en: As chief engineer, she was responsible for the safety of the entire bridge project.
ex.zh: 作为总工程师，她负责整个桥梁工程的安全。

ex.en: She majored in mechanical engineering at one of the country's top universities.
ex.zh: 她在全国顶尖的大学之一主修机械工程。

ex.en: The report warns that Britain faces a serious shortage of engineering graduates.
ex.zh: 报告警告说，英国面临工科毕业生严重短缺的问题。

ex.en: Genetic engineering holds promise for treating diseases that were once considered incurable.
ex.zh: 基因工程为治疗一度被认为无法治愈的疾病带来了希望。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

england.usage: adj. English；人 Englishman, Englishwoman; the English

ex.en: England was among the first European countries to establish a national system of primary education in the nineteenth century.
ex.zh: 英格兰是十九世纪最早建立国家初等教育体系的欧洲国家之一。

senses: v. 在……上雕刻(字或图案)

ex.en: The winner's name was engraved on the silver cup.
ex.zh: 获胜者的名字被刻在银杯上。

ex.en: Ancient craftsmen engraved intricate patterns onto the walls of the temple.
ex.zh: 古代工匠在神庙的墙壁上雕刻出复杂的图案。

ex.en: The jeweller offered to engrave her initials on the back of the watch.
ex.zh: 珠宝商提出要在手表背面刻上她姓名的首字母。

engross.usage: en-(进入)+gross(整体)→整个人陷进去→全神贯注

ex.en: She was so engrossed in her research that she completely forgot about the meeting scheduled for that afternoon.
ex.zh: 她全神贯注于研究，完全忘记了当天下午安排的会议。

senses: v. 提高（价格、质量、吸引力等），增加，增强
enhance.usage: [族] enhancement n. 增强；增加；en-（使）+hance（机会）→使有机会→增强。近义：strengthen vt. 加强；同义 raise, improve, better, enrich；反义 diminish 减少；派生 enhanced 加强的，增大的；enhancement n. 提高，增强

ex.en: This is an opportunity to enhance the reputation of the company.
ex.zh: 这是提高公司声誉的机会。

ex.en: For one person, the goal may be to be taken more seriously and enhance their professional image.
ex.zh: 对一个人来说，其目标可能是想更受重视，或提升其职业形象。

ex.en: The museum uses modern technology to enhance the visitor experience.
ex.zh: 博物馆利用现代技术提升游客体验。

ex.en: The report argues that technological enhancement of teaching does not automatically lead to better learning outcomes.
ex.zh: 报告认为，用技术手段提升教学并不一定会自动带来更好的学习效果。

senses: n. 难解之谜;费解的事物;令人困惑的处境

ex.en: To historians, the sudden collapse of this ancient civilization remains an enigma despite decades of careful study.
ex.zh: 对历史学家而言，这个古代文明的突然衰落尽管经过数十年仔细研究，仍是一个难解之谜。

senses: vt. 喜爱；欣赏；享受……的乐趣；享有；享受
v. 欣赏,喜爱,享受……乐趣

ex.en: Retirees in the town enjoy a mild climate and affordable health care.
ex.zh: 镇上的退休老人享有温和的气候和负担得起的医疗保健。

senses: v. 扩大，放大，增大；扩展，扩充
v. 扩大；扩充；扩展；增大；放大
enlarge.usage: en-（使）+ large（大的）→使扩大；同义 extend；派生 enlarged adj. 放大的，增大的；扩展的；索引p407

ex.en: Reading will enlarge your vocabulary.
ex.zh: 阅读能扩大词汇量。

ex.en: The hospital plans to enlarge its emergency department to cut waiting times.
ex.zh: 这家医院计划扩建急诊科以缩短等候时间。

ex.en: Please enlarge the photograph so we can read the sign in the background.
ex.zh: 请把这张照片放大，好让我们看清背景中的那个标志。

senses: v. ①启发，使摆脱偏见（或迷信）
enlighten.usage: 辨析：enlighten 启发、启蒙，搭配 enlighten sb. on sth.；instruct 指导、教导，搭配 instruct sb. in sth.；派生 enlightenment n. 启迪，启蒙运动；v.启发，开导，教化 environmentalists 同样反对fake 的动物garment，

ex.en: Applications like tumblr.com, which allow users to combine pictures, words and other media in creative ways and then share them, have the potential to add stickiness by amusing, entertaining and enlightening others.
ex.zh: 像tumblr.com这类应用软件，可以让用户将图片、文字和其他媒介创造性地结合起来然后共享，这些应用有可能通过愉悦、娱乐和启发他人的方式来增强黏性。

ex.en: The documentary aims to enlighten the public about the true cost of fast fashion.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片旨在启发公众认识快时尚的真正代价。

ex.en: His lectures enlighten students on issues that textbooks rarely discuss.
ex.zh: 他的讲授使学生们了解教科书上很少讨论的问题。

ex.en: Travel can enlighten people by exposing them to different cultures and values.
ex.zh: 旅行让人们接触不同的文化和价值观，从而启迪心智。

ex.en: The company adopted an enlightened approach to working hours, allowing employees to arrange their schedules flexibly.
ex.zh: 该公司采取了开明的工时制度，允许员工灵活安排自己的时间表。

ex.en: Philosophers of the Enlightenment believed that reason, rather than tradition, should guide human affairs.
ex.zh: 启蒙运动时期的哲学家认为，应当由理性而非传统来指导人类事务。

senses: adj. 巨大的；庞大的；极大的
enormous.usage: tremendous 的近义词；e-（超出）+norm（规则）+ous→超出常规的→巨大的。近义：immense a. 巨大的；e-（超出）+ norm（标准）→巨大的；[近]huge a. 巨大的；adj.巨大的，极大的；e（向外；超出）+norm（规范，基准）+ous（形容词后缀）→超出基准大小的→巨大的；庞大的；

ex.en: These designers came to exert enormous influence on the course of American architecture.
ex.zh: 这些设计师对美国建筑业的发展产生了巨大的影响。

ex.en: Cleaning up the river will cost an enormous amount of money and take several years.
ex.zh: 清理这条河流将花费巨额资金，并需要数年时间。

ex.en: enormous resource
ex.zh: 巨大的资源

ex.en: Digital technology has enormously expanded the range of courses available to students.
ex.zh: 数字技术极大地扩展了学生可选课程的范围。

ex.en: There is enough evidence to suggest that regular exercise improves mental health.
ex.zh: 有足够的证据表明，定期锻炼能改善心理健康。

ex.en: Journalists enquired repeatedly about the reasons for the minister's sudden resignation, but officials refused to comment.
ex.zh: 记者们反复询问部长突然辞职的原因，但官员们拒绝置评。

ex.en: Visitors may enquire at the reception desk about guided tours of the museum's newly opened galleries.
ex.zh: 游客可以在接待处询问博物馆新开放展厅的导览服务。

enquiry.usage: n.询问，查问；官方调查；问讯处

ex.en: The police launched a formal enquiry into the cause of the accident.
ex.zh: 警方对事故原因展开了正式调查。

senses: vt. 使异常愤怒；激怒；触怒
v. 使异常愤怒,激怒、触怒

ex.en: The sudden tax increase enraged small business owners across the state.
ex.zh: 突然增税使全州的小企业主勃然大怒。

ex.en: Consumers were enraged by the utility company's plan to raise prices again.
ex.zh: 公用事业公司再次涨价的计划激怒了消费者。

ex.en: It enrages many parents that tickets are resold at several times their face value.
ex.zh: 门票被以数倍于面值的价格转卖，这让许多家长怒不可遏。

ex.en: Residents were enraged by the council's decision to build a car park on the site of the historic garden.
ex.zh: 市政会决定在历史花园的旧址上修建停车场，居民们对此怒不可遏。

enrich.usage: en-（使）+ rich（丰富的）→使丰富；助记:en(动词前缀,使...)+rich(富有的)→使丰富；索引p407

ex.en: We may infer from the last paragraph that social class greatly helps enrich educational experiences.
ex.zh: 我们可以从最后一段推断出，社会阶层非常有助于丰富教育经历。

ex.en: Reading widely can enrich your vocabulary and deepen your understanding of the world.
ex.zh: 广泛阅读能丰富你的词汇量，加深你对世界的理解。

ex.en: The museum offers programmes designed to enrich the cultural life of local residents.
ex.zh: 博物馆提供各种项目，旨在丰富当地居民的文化生活。

ex.en: Immigrants have enriched American society with their skills and traditions.
ex.zh: 移民以其技能和传统丰富了美国社会。

enrol.usage: [族]enrolment n. 注册人数；en（使）+rol（卷）→使人卷入→（使）加入。

ex.en: Mr. Roth has three community-college students enrolled in a work-placement program.
ex.zh: 罗斯先生让三名社区大学的学生参与实习项目。

enrolenroll.usage: 派生enrolment登记,入学人数;辨析:enlist征募入伍;register正式记录,强调有记录在案

ex.en: The government urged parents to enrol their children in school before the deadline at the end of the month.
ex.zh: 政府敦促家长在月底截止日期前为孩子办理入学登记。

enroll.usage: en-（进入）+roll（名册）→进入名册→注册。近义：register v. 登记；注册；真 Mr. Roth has three community-college students enrolled in a work-placement program... (2017)；编注: work placement

ex.en: There is one step the TSA could take that would not require remodeling airports or rushing to hire: Enroll more people in the PreCheck program.
ex.zh: 美国运输安全管理局(TSA)可以采取的一个不必重修机场或匆忙招人的措施是：招募更多的预检人员。

ex.en: University enrollment has risen sharply over the past decade, placing considerable pressure on teaching staff and facilities.
ex.zh: 过去十年大学入学人数急剧上升，给师资和设施带来了相当大的压力。

ex.en: University enrolment has risen steadily over the past decade, especially among female students.
ex.zh: 过去十年大学入学人数稳步上升，女生人数增长尤为明显。

ex.en: The quartet performed as a remarkably unified ensemble, despite having rehearsed together for only a few weeks.
ex.zh: 这个四重奏组合配合得异常整齐，尽管他们共同排练只有几周时间。

ex.en: The exhibition traces the history of enslavement in the Atlantic world and its lasting social consequences.
ex.zh: 这次展览追溯了大西洋世界奴役制度的历史及其深远的社会后果。

ensure.usage: en-（使）+sure（确信的）→使确信→确保。近义：guarantee vt. 保证，担保；en-（使）+ sure（确信的）→确保；en(使)+sure(确定)→使确信→保证；确保；索引p408

ex.en: We are working to ensure the safety of people in the city.
ex.zh: 我们正在努力确保这个城市里人们的安全。

ex.en: Do we need quotas to ensure that women can continue to climb the corporate ladder fairly as they balance work and family?
ex.zh: 我们是否需要定额分配以保证女性能在平衡工作和家庭的同时，也拥有公平的晋升机会呢？

ex.en: Please check your answers carefully to ensure that there are no mistakes in the report.
ex.zh: 请仔细检查你的答案，确保报告中没有错误。

senses: 表人，名词词性；表具有……性质的，形容词词性

ex.en: In words such as 'resident' and 'confident', the suffix '-ent' denotes a person or a particular quality.
ex.zh: 在 resident 和 confident 等词中，后缀 -ent 表示人或某种性质。

senses: vt. 使(某事物)必要,牵涉,需要,带来,引起
entail.usage: en-（使）+tail（切割）→切给→必然承担。近义：involve vt. 牵涉；v.牵涉，涉及；使必要，需要； 限定继承；en（使进入）+tail（尾部）→使事情进入尾部→需要；例为2019年翻译；索引p408

ex.en: The job entails a lot of hard work.
ex.zh: 这工作需要十分艰苦的努力。

ex.en: Boiling down an individual's output to simple metrics, such as number of publications or journal impacts, entails considerable savings in time, energy and ambiguity.
ex.zh: 将个人的（研究）产出归结为简单的指标，如论文发表数量或刊物影响力，可以节省大量的时间、精力并且避免不确定性。

ex.en: Starting your own business entails considerable financial risk as well as personal sacrifice.
ex.zh: 自己创业不仅需要个人牺牲，还涉及相当大的财务风险。

senses: vt.&vi. 进来；进去；报名参加

ex.en: Only trained staff are allowed to enter the laboratory without supervision.
ex.zh: 只有受过训练的工作人员才被允许在无人监督的情况下进入实验室。

enterprise.usage: [族] entrepreneur n. 企业家；[族]entrepreneur n. 企业家；词根记忆：enter(between,在…之间)+prise(seize,抓住)→于众多事物中冒险抓住自己感兴趣的并不断深耕→事业；索引p408

ex.en: Since the days of Aristotle, a search for universal principles has characterized the scientific enterprise.
ex.zh: 从亚里士多德时代开始，科学事业的特点就是寻求普遍规律。

ex.en: Small enterprises create most of the new jobs in the local economy.
ex.zh: 小企业在当地经济中创造了大部分新的就业岗位。

ex.en: She showed remarkable enterprise by starting her own business at the age of nineteen.
ex.zh: 她十九岁就创办了自己的公司，展现出非凡的进取心。

ex.en: The joint enterprise between the two companies will build wind farms along the coast.
ex.zh: 这两家公司的合资企业将沿海岸建造风力发电场。

senses: v.（尤指在自己家中）招待，款待；使快乐，娱乐
entertain.usage: [族]entertainment n. 娱乐；同义: invite, treat; amuse, delight; 反义: bore；v.使有兴趣，使快乐；招待， 请客，娱乐；enter（进来）+tain（拿着）→进来就拿着。和同学去唱歌，有一个同学进去就拿着麦克风唱歌，只顾娱乐自己→娱乐，使快乐；串词记忆: 进入(e

ex.en: There are more avenues for us to entertain ourselves than ever before.
ex.zh: 我们自我娱乐的途径比以往任何时候都多。

ex.en: Applications like tumblr.com, which allow users to combine pictures, words and other media in creative ways and then share them, have the potential to add stickiness by amusing, entertaining and enlightening others.
ex.zh: 像汤博乐这样能让用户将图片、文字和其他媒体以创造性的方式组合并分享的应用，未来很可能可以通过消遣、娱乐和启发他人而增加用户黏性。

ex.en: The professor entertained the students with amusing stories from his years abroad.
ex.zh: 教授用他在国外多年遇到的趣闻逗学生们开心。

ex.en: The lecture was far more entertaining than the students had expected, and many stayed behind to ask questions.
ex.zh: 这场讲座比学生们预想的有趣得多，许多人留下来提问。

senses: n. 文娱节目,娱乐性表演
n. 娱乐片；表演会；娱乐活动；招待

ex.en: The city offers a wide range of entertainment, from concerts to street performances.
ex.zh: 这座城市提供丰富多彩的娱乐活动，从音乐会到街头表演不一而足。

ex.en: Streaming services have transformed the entertainment industry within a decade.
ex.zh: 流媒体服务在十年间改变了娱乐产业。

ex.en: The company cut entertainment expenses to cope with the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 为应对金融危机，公司削减了招待娱乐开支。

senses: n. 热情，热心；热衷的事物
enthusiasm.usage: [族]enthusiastic a. 热情的；派生enthusiast热情的人,热衷者;enthusiastically热情地；n.热情；热爱的事物；索引p408

ex.en: No disciplines have seized on professionalism with as much enthusiasm as the humanities.
ex.zh: 没有哪个学科像人文学科那样热衷于专业化。

ex.en: The new policy has been greeted with great enthusiasm by small business owners.
ex.zh: 新政策受到了小企业主的热烈欢迎。

ex.en: Her enthusiasm for scientific research impressed the interviewers deeply.
ex.zh: 她对科学研究的热情给面试官留下了深刻印象。

ex.en: As a keen enthusiast of early photography, he spent years collecting cameras from the nineteenth century.
ex.zh: 作为早期摄影的热心爱好者，他花了多年时间收藏十九世纪的相机。

ex.en: You don't sound very enthusiastic about the idea.
ex.zh: 你好像对这个想法不太感兴趣。

ex.en: The audience was enthusiastic about the young pianist's wonderful performance.
ex.zh: 观众对这位年轻钢琴家的精彩演出热情高涨。

ex.en: He is enthusiastic about joining the volunteer team to teach children in rural areas.
ex.zh: 他热心于加入志愿者队伍，去农村地区教孩子们。

ex.en: The proposal was enthusiastically welcomed by local businesses, who expected a sharp rise in tourism.
ex.zh: 该提案受到当地企业的热烈欢迎，他们预计旅游业将大幅增长。

ex.en: Retailers use discounts and free gifts to entice customers into spending more than they had originally planned.
ex.zh: 零售商利用折扣和赠品诱使顾客花费超出原本计划的金额。

senses: adj. 整体的,全部的,完整的
adj. 全部的，整个的；完全的
entire.usage: [近]whole a. 整个的；[近]whole a. 全部的；派生entirely完全地;entirety完全；en(使)+tire(疲劳，疲倦)→这件事儿使你“整个”人都很疲倦→整个的；索引p408

ex.en: The entire family gathered to celebrate the grandparents' golden wedding anniversary.
ex.zh: 全家人聚在一起庆祝祖父母的金婚纪念。

ex.en: The entire report runs to more than two hundred pages.
ex.zh: 整份报告长达两百多页。

ex.en: Heavy snow disrupted the entire transport network across the northern provinces.
ex.zh: 大雪使北方各省的整个交通网络陷入瘫痪。

entirely.usage: adv.整个的，完全地，完整地；索引p408

ex.en: But, the wonderful thing about failure is that it's entirely up to us to decide how to look at it.
ex.zh: 但是关于失败最神奇的事情在于，完全由我们自己决定如何看待它。

ex.en: The two accounts of the accident were not entirely consistent with each other.
ex.zh: 对这起事故的两种说法并不完全一致。

ex.en: Whether the project succeeds depends entirely on the support of local communities.
ex.zh: 项目能否成功完全取决于当地社区的支持。

ex.en: I entirely agree that children should spend less time on electronic devices.
ex.zh: 我完全赞同孩子应该少花时间使用电子设备。

entitle.usage: [族] entitlement n. 权利；津贴；be entitled to do sth.有资格做某事；助记:en(使)+title(标题)→题名;反义deprive剥夺;派生entitlement应得权利；en（使）+title（标题）→使有个头衔就可以做事了→给权利；联想记忆：en(make,使)+title(

ex.en: You will be entitled to your pension when you reach 65.
ex.zh: 你到65岁就有资格领取养老金。

ex.en: The court, though, may want to allow room for police to cite situations where they are entitled to more freedom.
ex.zh: 尽管如此，最高法院或许还是会想要为警方引证留下空间，让他们在某些情况下有权做出更多自主行为。

ex.en: In an essay entitled "Making It in America," the author Adam Davidson relates a joke from cotton country about just how much a modern textile mill has been automated.
ex.zh: 在一篇名为《美国制造》的文章中，作者亚当·戴维森讲述了一个来自棉花产区有关现代纺织厂如何被高度自动化的笑话。

entitlement.usage: n.权利，资格；政府津贴；索引p408

ex.en: Critics argue that the new policy reduces workers' entitlement to paid sick leave.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，新政策减少了工人享受带薪病假的权利。

entity.usage: 助记:我的identity(身份)是entity(实体)店的老板；索引p408

ex.en: The two firms will merge to form a single legal entity by the end of the year.
ex.zh: 两家公司将于年底前合并组成一个单一的法律实体。

ex.en: The president arrived at the summit with a large entourage of advisers and security guards.
ex.zh: 总统在大批顾问和保安人员的随行下抵达峰会。

ex.en: The main entrance to the museum is closed for repairs, so visitors must use the side door.
ex.zh: 博物馆正门因维修而关闭，游客须从侧门进入。

senses: n. 承包人,主办人,促进者
entrepreneur.usage: 派生entrepreneurial企业的；n.企业家；索引p408

ex.en: The young entrepreneur launched her start-up with borrowed money and sheer determination.
ex.zh: 这位年轻的企业家靠借来的钱和纯粹的决心创办了自己的初创公司。

ex.en: Successful entrepreneurs tend to see failure as a lesson rather than a defeat.
ex.zh: 成功的企业家往往把失败看作教训而非挫败。

ex.en: The programme trains aspiring entrepreneurs in marketing, finance and management.
ex.zh: 该项目为有抱负的企业家提供市场营销、财务和管理方面的培训。

senses: n. 创业精神；企业家(身份、行为)；企业家精神

ex.en: The course aims to foster entrepreneurship among graduates who might otherwise seek conventional employment.
ex.zh: 这门课程旨在培养毕业生的创业精神，否则他们可能会去寻求传统的就业岗位。

ex.en: Parents entrust schools with the responsibility of educating their children.
ex.zh: 父母将教育孩子的责任托付给学校。

senses: n. 进入（指行动）；加入（指权利、机会）

ex.en: Entry to the competition is free, and participants may submit up to three photographs.
ex.zh: 比赛免费参赛，参赛者最多可提交三张照片。

ex.en: She sealed the envelope, put a stamp on it, and dropped it into the mailbox.
ex.zh: 她封好信封，贴上邮票，把它投进了邮筒。

ex.en: The firm has built an enviable reputation for reliability over the past fifty years.
ex.zh: 五十年来，这家公司以可靠赢得了令人羡慕的声誉。

ex.en: Colleagues were envious of her rapid promotion, though few were willing to admit it openly.
ex.zh: 同事们嫉妒她升职如此之快，尽管很少有人愿意公开承认。

senses: n. 环境,外界,客观环境
n. 自然环境,生态环境
environment.usage: [族] environmental a. 环境的；[族]environmental a. 环境的；索引p408

ex.en: Factories must be prevented from dumping waste that damages the environment.
ex.zh: 必须防止工厂倾倒破坏环境的废物。

ex.en: A quiet working environment helps employees concentrate on complex tasks.
ex.zh: 安静的工作环境有助于员工专注于复杂的任务。

ex.en: Children raised in a supportive home environment tend to perform better at school.
ex.zh: 在支持性家庭环境中长大的孩子往往在学校表现更好。

ex.en: The government faces growing pressure to tighten environmental regulations on factories.
ex.zh: 政府面临越来越大的压力，要求加强对工厂的环境监管。

ex.en: The environmentalist argued that economic growth cannot be sustained if natural resources are exploited at the current rate.
ex.zh: 这位环保主义者认为，如果自然资源继续以目前的速度被开采，经济增长就无法持续。

ex.en: Consumers claim to be environmentally conscious, yet their purchasing habits often tell a rather different story.
ex.zh: 消费者自称有环保意识，但他们的购买习惯往往呈现出相当不同的情况。

senses: vt. 展望,想象;正视,面对(事实等)
envisage.usage: 助记:en(动词前缀)+vis(see看)+age(动词后缀)→正视；v.设想，展望；en(使……)+vis(看)+age(名词后缀)→使某人像看到一样→想象；索引p408

ex.en: It's perhaps best left to science-fiction writers and futurologists to explore the many possibilities we can envisage.
ex.zh: 或许最好的办法是将我们能够想象到的各种可能性留给科幻小说家和未来学家去探索。

ex.en: The planners envisage a city where no private cars are allowed in the centre.
ex.zh: 规划者设想了一座市中心禁止私家车通行的城市。

ex.en: Nobody envisaged that the project would take more than ten years to complete.
ex.zh: 没有人预料到该项目需要十多年才能完成。

ex.en: That's because Congress has always envisioned joint federal-state immigration enforcement and explicitly encourages state officers to share information and cooperate with federal colleagues.
ex.zh: 这是因为国会往往设想联邦政府能和州政府联合实施移民法，而且明确鼓励州政府官员与联邦同僚分享信息并合作。

ex.en: The architects envisioned a city where green spaces connect every neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 建筑师们构想了一座绿色空间连接每个街区的城市。

ex.en: She envisioned a future in which robots would handle most routine work.
ex.zh: 她设想了一个由机器人处理大部分例行工作的未来。

ex.en: It is hard to envision how the industry will look in twenty years.
ex.zh: 很难设想二十年后这个行业会是什么样子。

phrases.m: 成为羡慕(或忌妒)的对象/东西

envy.usage: [近]jealousy n. 嫉妒；发音类似“安慰”→安慰自己，不要动不动“羡慕”别人；索引p408

ex.en: By most recent measures, the UK's GDP has been the envy of the Western world, with record low unemployment and high growth figures.
ex.zh: 根据近期大多数评估，英国的国内生产总值(GDP)一直令西方世界羡慕，失业率史上最低，(生产)增长值较高。

ex.en: I rather envy her ability to remain calm in a crisis.
ex.zh: 我着实羡慕她在危机中保持镇定的能力。

ex.en: The garden is the envy of the whole neighborhood.
ex.zh: 这座花园让街坊四邻都羡慕不已。

senses: n. ①史诗；史诗般的作品(c/u)
adj. ①史诗般的；壮丽的，宏大的；②艰苦卓绝的，漫长而艰难的

ex.en: The film is an epic account of one family's struggle to survive three generations of war and hardship.
ex.zh: 这部电影史诗般地讲述了一个家庭历经三代战乱与苦难求生存的故事。

senses: n. 流行病；（消息等的）传播
adj. 流行性的，极为盛行的
epidemic.usage: n.流行病，传染病；盛行，蔓延 adj.盛行的，泛滥的；epi（发音类似“爱扑”）+demic（联想成 academic“学术上”）→爱扑在学术研究上，现在很“流行”。；索引p408

ex.en: Over fifty people died during the flu epidemic last winter.
ex.zh: 在去年冬天的一场流感中有50多人丧生。

ex.en: Doctors warned that obesity is becoming an epidemic among schoolchildren.
ex.zh: 医生们警告说，肥胖正在中小学生中间成为一种流行病。

ex.en: The government took immediate action to prevent the epidemic from spreading to big cities.
ex.zh: 政府立即采取行动，防止疫情蔓延到大城市。

senses: n. 插曲，一段情节，片段；一集

ex.en: This episode crystallizes the irony that although American men tend to talk more than women in public situations, they often talk less at home.
ex.zh: 这个情节明确了一个具有讽刺意味的现象：尽管在公共场合，美国男性往往比女性健谈，但他们在家里却很少说话。

ex.en: The final episode of the documentary attracted millions of viewers.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片的最后一集吸引了数百万观众。

ex.en: The country's latest political episode has unsettled foreign investors.
ex.zh: 该国最近这场政治风波令外国投资者感到不安。

ex.en: The poet chose as his epitaph a single line from his most famous work.
ex.zh: 诗人从自己最著名的作品中选了一行诗作为墓志铭。

senses: n. [C] 表述形容词，修饰语

ex.en: The region earned the epithet 'the breadbasket of the nation' because of its extraordinarily fertile soil.
ex.zh: 该地区因其异常肥沃的土壤而获得了“国家粮仓”的称号。

ex.en: The invention of printing marked an epoch in the history of human communication.
ex.zh: 印刷术的发明标志着人类传播史上的一个新时代。

ex.en: Darwin's theory was an epochal contribution that reshaped the way scientists thought about life on Earth.
ex.zh: 达尔文的理论是一项划时代的贡献，重塑了科学家对地球上生命的思考方式。

ex.en: In 'equator' and 'equilibrium', the root 'equ-' carries the idea of equality or balance.
ex.zh: 在 equator 和 equilibrium 等词中，词根 equ- 含有相等或平衡之意。

equal.usage: be equal to doing sth.能胜任做某事；反义unequal;关联词equalitarian平均主义的;equalize使均等;equally相等地；索引p408

ex.en: I believe everyone is born equal.
ex.zh: 我认为人人生来平等。

ex.en: The idea that "housing crisis" equals "concreted meadows" is pure lobby talk.
ex.zh: "住房危机"导致"绿地水泥化"的这种观点纯属游说之词。

ex.en: In a fair system, equal effort should lead to equal reward.
ex.zh: 在公平的制度中，同等的努力应获得同等的回报。

equality.usage: 反义inequality;助记:equal(相等的)+ity(名词后缀)→平等；n.平等；索引p408

ex.en: We need to ensure equality of opportunity in all areas of work.
ex.zh: 我们需要确保在各个工作领域都机会均等。

ex.en: The constitution guarantees equality before the law for every citizen.
ex.zh: 宪法保障每位公民在法律面前一律平等。

ex.en: The campaign fights for greater equality between men and women in pay.
ex.zh: 这场运动争取男女在薪酬方面更加平等。

senses: adv. 相等地，平等地；平均地
adv. 平等地；同样地；(引出同样重要的内容)同样

ex.en: Equally, there is a sense that the travails of commuters in the South East, many of whom will face among the biggest rises, have received too much attention compared to those who must endure the relatively poor infrastructure of the Midlands and the North.
ex.zh: 同样，有这样一种观点：与那些必须忍受中部和北部地区相对落后的铁路基础设施的人相比，东南部地区通勤者的出行困境得到了过多的关注，他们中的许多人将负担最高额的增长费用。

senses: n. [C常用sing.]（须综合考虑的）影响因素

phrases.p: the equation of wealth with happiness

equation.usage: equ（相等）+-ation（名词后缀）→相等。族equate vt.同等看待；使等同；索引p408

ex.en: In the equation of job satisfaction, salary is only one variable.
ex.zh: 在工作满意度这个等式中，薪水只是其中一个变量。

ex.en: The students learned to solve a simple equation with two unknowns.
ex.zh: 学生们学会了求解含两个未知数的简单方程。

ex.en: Public trust is a crucial part of the political equation.
ex.zh: 公众信任是政治格局中至关重要的一环。

equator.usage: 助记:equat(e)(使相等)+or(名词后缀)→赤道

ex.en: Countries near the equator receive more direct sunlight throughout the year than those at higher latitudes.
ex.zh: 与高纬度地区相比，赤道附近的国家全年接收更多直射阳光。

senses: v. 装备，配备；使有能力

ex.en: All riders are equipped with reflective vests and safety lights.
ex.zh: 所有骑手都配有反光背心和安全灯。

ex.en: There is a gap in working-class jobs, but the workers who need those jobs most aren't equipped to do them.
ex.zh: 工人阶层职位有空缺，但是最需要这些职位的工人大部分都不能够胜任这些工作。

ex.en: The training course is designed to equip graduates with practical office skills.
ex.zh: 这门培训课程旨在使毕业生具备实用的办公技能。

equipment.usage: 助记:equip(装备)+ment(名词后缀)→装置；n.设备；装备；索引p408

ex.en: First, he bought new equipment for one of the departments.
ex.zh: 首先，他为其中一个部门购买了新设备。

ex.en: The laboratory is fitted with modern equipment for chemical analysis.
ex.zh: 实验室配备了用于化学分析的现代设备。

ex.en: Campers should carry basic safety equipment when travelling in the mountains.
ex.zh: 露营者在山间旅行时应携带基本的安全装备。

ex.en: The reform aims to promote equity in access to health care across all income groups.
ex.zh: 改革旨在促进各收入群体在获得医疗保健方面的公平性。

equivalent.usage: be equivalent to...相当于……；同义match,substitute;反义different;关联词equitable公平的;equity公平;equivalence等价；equi（=equal相等）+val（=value价值）+ent→最终价值相等→等价；词根记忆：equ(equal, 平等的)+i

ex.en: In a society that so persistently celebrates procreation, is it any wonder that admitting you regret having children is equivalent to admitting you support kitten-killing?
ex.zh: 在一个如此执着于颂扬生育的社会里，承认后悔生孩子就相当于承认支持杀死小猫，这有什么奇怪的吗？

ex.en: One mile is equivalent to about 1.6 kilometres.
ex.zh: 一英里大约相当于1.6公里。

ex.en: Her silence was equivalent to an admission of guilt.
ex.zh: 她的沉默等同于认罪。

senses: 表物、人，名词词性；动词词性

ex.en: The suffix '-er' typically turns a verb into a noun denoting the person who performs the action, as in 'writer'.
ex.zh: 后缀 -er 通常把动词变成名词，表示执行该动作的人，如 writer。

ex.en: The difference between today's workplace and the "dress for success" era is that the range of options is so much broader.
ex.zh: 如今的工作场所与"穿出成功"时代的区别在于(着装)选择的范围更加宽泛。

ex.en: The invention of the internet ushered in a new era of global communication.
ex.zh: 互联网的发明开启了全球通信的新时代。

ex.en: The war brought an end to an era of rapid economic expansion.
ex.zh: 战争终结了一个经济快速扩张的时代。

ex.en: We are entering an era in which data is more valuable than oil.
ex.zh: 我们正在进入一个数据比石油更有价值的时代。

ex.en: Global vaccination campaigns helped eradicate smallpox in the late twentieth century.
ex.zh: 全球疫苗接种运动帮助人类在二十世纪末消灭了天花。

ex.en: It is almost impossible to eradicate corruption without an independent judiciary.
ex.zh: 没有独立的司法机构，几乎不可能根除腐败。

ex.en: The charity aims to eradicate extreme poverty in the region within a decade.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构的目标是在十年内消除该地区的极端贫困。

senses: vt. 抹去（磁带录音或存储器信息）
erase.usage: [族]erasure n.擦掉；抹掉；[近]efface vt.消除；擦掉；同义cancel

ex.en: Half of the participants were told the information would be erased.
ex.zh: 一半的参与者被告知信息将被删除。

ex.en: Nothing can erase the memory of that terrible summer.
ex.zh: 什么都无法抹去那个可怕夏天的记忆。

ex.en: He erased the wrong answer and wrote the correct one in its place.
ex.zh: 他擦掉了错误答案，写上了正确答案。

ex.en: The team worked hard to erase a two-goal deficit in the second half.
ex.zh: 球队在下半场奋力拼搏，试图抹平两球的差距。

senses: adj. 坚直的,垂直的,竖起的

phrases.p: be erected on the other side

erect.usage: [族] erection n. 建造 [近] construct vt. 建造；辨析:erect修建立体物;build建思想体系;construct组建;establish建机构；索引p408

ex.en: The villagers erected a monument in honour of those who died in the flood.
ex.zh: 村民们建起一座纪念碑，纪念在洪水中遇难的人们。

ex.en: The company plans to erect a new office tower on this site.
ex.zh: 公司计划在这块地上建一座新办公楼。

ex.en: Protesters erected tents outside the parliament building and refused to leave.
ex.zh: 抗议者在议会大厦外搭起帐篷，拒绝离开。

ex.en: Derived from the Greek root 'erg-', meaning energy, words such as 'ergonomics' concern work and human power.
ex.zh: 源自希腊语词根 erg-（意为能量），ergonomics 等词涉及工作与人的力量。

senses: vt. 逐渐毁坏；削弱；损害
v. 逐渐毁坏,削弱,损害
erode.usage: 同义wear away;关联:erotic色情的;erotica黄色作品;eroticism色情性,性欲

ex.en: Constant criticism can erode a child's confidence in his or her own abilities.
ex.zh: 不断的批评会逐渐削弱孩子对自身能力的信心。

ex.en: Intensive farming has accelerated the erosion of topsoil, reducing the land's long-term productivity.
ex.zh: 集约化农业加速了表土的侵蚀，降低了土地的长期生产力。

ex.en: He sent his assistant on an errand to deliver the signed contract before the office closed.
ex.zh: 他派助手去办一件差事，要赶在办公室下班前把签好的合同送去。

ex.en: The article was withdrawn after readers pointed out several erroneous figures.
ex.zh: 读者指出文中几处数据有误后，这篇文章被撤下。

ex.en: It is erroneous to assume that older workers cannot learn new technology.
ex.zh: 认为年长员工学不会新技术的假设是错误的。

ex.en: The court ruled that the arrest was based on erroneous information.
ex.zh: 法庭裁定这次逮捕是基于错误信息作出的。

error.usage: [近]mistake n. 错误；同根:errant漂泊的;erring误入歧途的;erratic飘忽不定;aberrant变态的,异常的；n.错误，差错；发音类似“哎哟”→哎哟，我犯了一个“错误”

ex.en: Good writing most often occurs when you are in hot pursuit of an idea rather than in a nervous search for errors.
ex.zh: 好的文章通常出现在你狂热追求一个想法之时，而不是在紧张地寻找错误的时候。

ex.en: A small error in the code brought down the entire booking system.
ex.zh: 代码中的一个小错误使整个订票系统瘫痪。

ex.en: The pilot's quick thinking corrected a potentially fatal error.
ex.zh: 飞行员临机应变，纠正了一个可能致命的差错。

senses: vi. （火山）爆发；（岩浆、烟等）喷出
v. (战争、危机等)爆发,突然发生
v. 爆发，喷出；突然发生
erupt.usage: [记] e-（出）+rupt（破坏）→火山岩浆破坏性地冲出地表。；助记:e(出去)+rupt(打破)→喷发;派生eruption喷发,爆发；v.喷发；爆发，突然发生；e（出）+rupt（断裂）→因断裂而喷出→爆发，喷出。派生：eruption；词根记忆: e(out, 出来)+rupt(break, 断裂)→断裂后喷出

ex.en: There are signs that the volcano will erupt again in the near future.
ex.zh: 有迹象表明，这座火山将在不久的将来再次爆发。

ex.en: Protests have erupted over construction of the Thirty Meter Telescope (TMT), a giant observatory that promises to revolutionize humanity's view of the cosmos.
ex.zh: 建造“30米望远镜”引发了大量抗议，而这个巨型天文台据说可以使人类对宇宙的认识发生巨大变革。

ex.en: Fighting erupted between the two groups shortly after the peace talks broke down.
ex.zh: 和谈破裂后不久，两派之间爆发了战斗。

eruption.usage: [族] eruptive a. 火山爆发的；n.喷发；(战争、怒气等的)爆 发；发疹；erupt 的派生词

ex.en: The eruption of the volcano forced thousands of residents to flee their homes.
ex.zh: 火山喷发迫使数千居民逃离家园。

ex.en: An eruption of public anger followed the publication of the report.
ex.zh: 报告发布后，公众怒火爆发。

ex.en: Scientists monitor the volcano closely for signs of a possible eruption.
ex.zh: 科学家密切监测这座火山，寻找可能喷发的迹象。

ex.en: The island's eruptive history suggests that another major volcanic event is possible, though not imminent.
ex.zh: 该岛的火山喷发史表明，再次发生大规模喷发是有可能的，尽管并不迫在眉睫。

senses: 表状态、场所，名词词性；表示性质，名词词性

ex.en: The suffix '-ery' can denote a place or a state, as in 'bakery' and 'bravery'.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ery 可以表示场所或状态，如 bakery 和 bravery。

senses: vt.&vi. （使）逐步扩大，不断恶化，加剧

ex.en: Officials fear that the trade dispute could escalate into a full-scale trade war.
ex.zh: 官员们担心这场贸易争端可能升级为全面的贸易战。

ex.en: The prisoner managed to escape through a narrow window while the guards were changing shifts.
ex.zh: 趁狱警换班之机，那名囚犯设法从一扇狭窄的窗户逃走了。

senses: n. 逃避主义；逃避现实

ex.en: Critics dismiss such novels as mere escapism, yet their popularity reveals a deep public need for comfort.
ex.zh: 批评者贬斥这类小说只是逃避现实的消遣，但它们的流行表明公众深处需要慰藉。

ex.en: A police escort guided the president's car through the crowded streets.
ex.zh: 一队警察护卫引导总统的车穿过拥挤的街道。

ex.en: The reading scheme targets young readers, esp. those from families with few books at home.
ex.zh: 这项阅读计划面向年轻读者，尤其是家中藏书不多的孩子。

senses: ad. 尤其；专门；十分；非常

ex.en: Small businesses have been hit hard by the recession, especially in rural areas.
ex.zh: 小企业受到经济衰退的严重打击，农村地区尤其如此。

ex.en: The exam is difficult for non-native speakers, especially the listening section.
ex.zh: 这项考试对非母语者来说很难，听力部分尤其如此。

ex.en: Traffic noise is a growing problem, especially near schools and hospitals.
ex.zh: 交通噪音是一个日益严重的问题，在学校和医院附近尤为突出。

ex.en: In 'essence' and 'essential', the root 'ess-' relates to being or existence.
ex.zh: 在 essence 和 essential 中，词根 ess- 与“存在”相关。

ex.en: Students are required to write a 2,000-word essay on one of the topics discussed in class.
ex.zh: 学生须就课堂讨论的主题之一写一篇2000词的文章。

phrases.m: 极其重要的，必不可少的

essence.usage: ess（存在）+-ence（名词后缀）→事物存在的根本属性→本质。族essential a.本质的；essentially ad.本质上；n.本质，要素；香精，香 料；索引p408

ex.en: The Administration was in essence asserting that because it didn't want to carry out Congress's immigration wishes, no state should be allowed to do so either.
ex.zh: 美国政府实质上是在宣称：因为它不想执行国会在移民方面的意愿，所以任何州也不应该被允许这样做。

ex.en: The essence of his argument is that freedom carries responsibility.
ex.zh: 他论点的实质是自由伴随着责任。

ex.en: Time is of the essence in emergency rescue operations.
ex.zh: 在紧急救援行动中，时间至关重要。

senses: a. 必要的；必不可少的
essential.usage: es(出)+sent(存在)+ial→存在的→本质的；[族] essence n. 本质；be essential to/for...对……必不可少；名词essence精华对女生来说是必不可少的东西；索引p408

ex.en: Vitamins play an essential role in many body processes.
ex.zh: 维生素在身体的许多过程中起着重要作用。

ex.en: It's true that high-school coding classes aren't essential for learning computer science in college.
ex.zh: 没错，对于（在大学）学习计算机科学课程来说，高中编程课程的学习并非必要。

ex.en: It is essential that all passengers fasten their seat belts before take-off.
ex.zh: 所有乘客在起飞前系好安全带是绝对必要的。

senses: adv. 本质上;根本上;基本上
essentially.usage: adv.本质上，根本上；基 本上；索引p408

ex.en: The two proposals are essentially identical in their approach to the problem.
ex.zh: 这两项提案在解决问题的方式上本质相同。

ex.en: Essentially, the debate is about how much freedom markets should be given.
ex.zh: 从本质上讲，这场辩论关乎应给市场多大自由。

ex.en: The new device is essentially a smaller and cheaper version of the original model.
ex.zh: 新设备本质上是原机型更小、更便宜的版本。

establish.usage: 链P119；[族]establishment n. 建立；①vt.建立(2019年阅读) ②确立地位(2007年翻译):If the study of law is beginning to establish itself as part and parcel of a general education, its

ex.en: The school is trying to establish a relationship with the local community.
ex.zh: 学校正试图与当地社区建立关系。

ex.en: Along with Singapore, other governments and mega-corporations are beginning to establish their own guidelines.
ex.zh: 与新加坡一样，其他国家的政府和特大公司都在着手制定自己的指导准则。

ex.en: Researchers have established a clear link between sleep loss and poor memory.
ex.zh: 研究人员已经确定睡眠不足与记忆力差之间存在明显联系。

senses: n. 成立，建立，创立；企业，机构

ex.en: The speaker announced the establishment of a new college.
ex.zh: 发言人宣布了新学院的成立。

ex.en: The establishment of the research centre attracted top scientists from around the world.
ex.zh: 该研究中心的建立吸引了世界各地的顶尖科学家。

ex.en: The restaurant is a popular eating establishment among local office workers.
ex.zh: 这家餐馆很受当地上班族欢迎。

ex.en: Critics accused the media establishment of ignoring the voices of ordinary people.
ex.zh: 批评者指责媒体机构无视普通民众的声音。

senses: n. 个人财产；遗产；工业区
estate.usage: 发音类似"爱死他的"→最放不下的是财产→个人财产；词根记忆：e(表加强)+stat(stand,站)+e→站在自家土地上→地产；索引p408

ex.en: If we know we will overreact to consumer products or housing options when we see a happy face (one reason good sales representatives and real estate agents are always smiling), we can take a moment before buying.
ex.zh: 如果我们知道，自己在选择消费品或房屋时看见笑脸会作出过度反应（这是优秀销售代表和房地产经纪人总是面带笑容的原因之一），我们可以在购买之前花点时间考虑清楚。

ex.en: The industrial estate on the outskirts of town has attracted dozens of manufacturers.
ex.zh: 市郊的工业区已吸引了数十家制造商。

ex.en: After his death, the estate was divided equally among his three children.
ex.zh: 他去世后，遗产在三个子女之间平均分配。

senses: v. 尊重，敬重；把……看作；认为
esteem.usage: est（最高级）+ee（联想成"两只眼睛"）+m→最大限度地睁大两只眼睛看，以表示"尊重"与"敬重"→尊重，敬重；索引p408

ex.en: We become defensive when criticised, and apply negative stereotypes to others to boost our own esteem.
ex.zh: 当受到批评时，我们会变得防御，并将负面的刻板印象应用于他人以提高自己的自尊。

ex.en: Regular exercise can improve self-esteem and reduce symptoms of depression.
ex.zh: 定期锻炼能提升自尊，减轻抑郁症状。

ex.en: She is held in high esteem by her colleagues for her honesty.
ex.zh: 她为人诚实，深受同事的敬重。

ex.en: The professor is widely esteemed for his contributions to economics.
ex.zh: 这位教授因其对经济学的贡献而广受尊敬。

estimate.usage: [近]assess vt. 评估；v.估计；评价 n.估计，估价；est(最高级)+i(我)+m+ate→我得估算一下干什么赚最多钱；索引p408

ex.en: Police estimate the crowd at 30,000.
ex.zh: 警方估计聚集的人有3万。

ex.en: In America, the core scientific publishing market is estimated at between $7 billion and $11 billion.
ex.zh: 据估算，美国科研核心出版物的市场价值在70亿到110亿美元之间。

ex.en: Engineers estimate that repairing the bridge will take at least six months.
ex.zh: 工程师估计，修复这座桥至少需要六个月。

senses: et alii (=and others), et alibi (=and elsewhere)

ex.en: Several researchers (Smith et al., 2019) have questioned whether the results can be replicated outside the laboratory.
ex.zh: 一些研究者（Smith 等人，2019）质疑这些结果能否在实验室之外得到重复验证。

ex.en: The store sells stationery, batteries, cleaning products, etc., at competitive prices.
ex.zh: 这家商店以有竞争力的价格出售文具、电池、清洁用品等商品。

senses: adj. 永恒的,永存的,永久的

ex.en: A wedding ring is a symbol of eternal love.
ex.zh: 结婚戒指是永恒爱情的象征。

senses: n. ①道德体系，道德准则，伦理标准；行为准则
n. 伦理标准，道德准则

ex.en: He began to question the ethics of his position.
ex.zh: 他开始对他的立场是否符合道德准则提出疑问。

ex.en: A strong work ethic helped the company survive its difficult early years.
ex.zh: 强烈的敬业精神帮助公司度过了艰难的创业期。

ex.en: Doctors are bound by a professional ethic to protect patient privacy.
ex.zh: 职业道德要求医生保护病人隐私。

ex.en: The team had a strict ethic of never exaggerating experimental results.
ex.zh: 该团队恪守从不夸大实验结果的严格准则。

senses: adj. 道德的；伦理的；合乎道德的
ethical.usage: adj.道德的，伦理的；合乎道 德的；索引p408

ex.en: The company faced questions about the ethical implications of its data-mining practices.
ex.zh: 该公司因其数据挖掘行为的伦理影响而受到质疑。

ex.en: There is an ethical obligation to inform participants of the risks involved in the study.
ex.zh: 从伦理上讲，有义务告知参与者研究中的风险。

ex.en: Consumers are increasingly willing to pay more for ethically produced goods.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越愿意为符合道德标准生产的商品支付更高价格。

senses: adv. 道德上地；伦理上地
ethically.usage: adv.合乎道德地；伦理上 反对slaves 的声音mainly 来自在美国北方。他们认为黑人可以去特定type 的agency 中工作，可以有自己 的aim 和belief, 贡献unique 的价值，enhance 对于黑人的cure,；索引p408

ex.en: The treatment is technically possible, but many doctors question whether it is ethically acceptable.
ex.zh: 这种疗法在技术上可行，但许多医生质疑其在伦理上是否可以接受。

senses: n. 道德准则；伦理学，伦理；道德体系

ex.en: But it did so while holding its nose at the ethics of his conduct, which included accepting gifts such as a Rolex watch and a Ferrari automobile from a company seeking access to government.
ex.zh: 但与此同时，它（指最高法院）对他的行为准则嗤之以鼻，他曾接受一家公司的礼物，如劳力士手表和法拉利汽车，这家公司试图以此打通政府关系。

senses: n. 少数民族成员，种族集团成员
adj. 种族的，民族的；具有民族特色的

ex.en: There are continuing ethnic tensions in the region.
ex.zh: 该地区种族关系持续紧张。

ex.en: The festival celebrates the ethnic diversity of the city's population.
ex.zh: 这个节日颂扬该市人口的民族多样性。

ex.en: Restaurants serving ethnic food have become popular among young city dwellers.
ex.zh: 供应民族风味菜肴的餐馆在城市年轻人中广受欢迎。

senses: n. 种族渊源,种族特点
n. 民族；种族渊源；种族特点

ex.en: The census records residents' age, income, and ethnicity to help plan public services.
ex.zh: 人口普查记录居民的年龄、收入和种族，以帮助规划公共服务。

senses: n. (个人或团体的)精神特质;道德观;理念

ex.en: The school's ethos encourages pupils to take responsibility for their own learning from an early age.
ex.zh: 这所学校的精神理念鼓励学生从小学会为自己的学习负责。

senses: 表示“关于……的”，形容词词性

ex.en: Adjectives ending in '-etic', such as 'energetic' and 'synthetic', describe a particular quality.
ex.zh: 以 -etic 结尾的形容词，如 energetic 和 synthetic，表示某种特定的性质。

ex.en: At the memorial service, an old friend delivered a moving eulogy celebrating the scientist's quiet generosity.
ex.zh: 在追悼会上，一位老友致了感人的悼词，赞颂这位科学家默默的慷慨。

ex.en: French borrowings ending in '-eur', such as 'entrepreneur' and 'connoisseur', usually denote a person who does something.
ex.zh: 以 -eur 结尾的法语借词，如 entrepreneur 和 connoisseur，通常表示做某事的人。

europe.usage: 附录Ⅱ 大洲名；形容词 European

ex.en: Europe experienced sustained economic growth in the decades following the Second World War.
ex.zh: 第二次世界大战后的几十年里，欧洲经历了持续的经济增长。

ex.en: The European Union was founded to promote economic cooperation among countries that had fought two devastating wars.
ex.zh: 欧盟的成立是为了促进曾经历两场毁灭性战争的国家之间的经济合作。

ex.en: Authorities were forced to evacuate thousands of residents after floodwaters breached the town's defences.
ex.zh: 洪水冲垮了该镇的防洪设施后，当局被迫疏散数千名居民。

ex.en: The evacuation of the building was completed within minutes, thanks to regular fire drills.
ex.zh: 由于定期进行消防演习，大楼的疏散在几分钟内就完成了。

senses: vt. 规避（尤指法律或道德责任）；回避（处理或谈论某事）；未发生在（某人）身上；逃脱

phrases.p: evade the pressure from their peers
phrases.m: 避开来自同龄人的压力

evade.usage: v.规避，逃避；规避；词根记忆：e(out，出)+vad(go，走)+e(往外走)→逃脱；辨析：通常指通过某些手段逃避履行责任或义务；索引p408

ex.en: The minister was criticised for evading questions about the tax scandal.
ex.zh: 这位部长因回避有关税收丑闻的问题而受到批评。

ex.en: Some wealthy individuals evade taxes by hiding their income overseas.
ex.zh: 一些富人通过向海外隐藏收入来逃税。

ex.en: He narrowly evaded a speeding fine by proving his car had been sold.
ex.zh: 他证明那辆车已经卖掉，勉强逃过了超速罚款。

evaluate.usage: assess 的近义词；v.评价、评估；v.评价，评估；e（出来）+valu（=value价值）+ate（动词后缀）→把价值说出来；索引p408

ex.en: We need to learn how to evaluate them properly. A large part of evaluation is calling out bad arguments, but we also need to admit good arguments by opponents and to apply the same critical standards to ourselves.
ex.zh: 我们需要学习如何正确地评估它们。大部分的评价都是在吹嘘不好的论点，但是我们也需要承认对手的好论点，并把同样的批评标准应用到我们自己身上。

ex.en: We need to learn how to evaluate them properly.
ex.zh: 我们需要学习如何正确评估它们。

evaluation.usage: n.估价，赋值，估计价值，诊断；n.评价，评估；索引p408

ex.en: I hear the students gave the new teacher an unfair evaluation.
ex.zh: 我听说学生们给新老师的评价不公平。

ex.en: Employees receive an annual evaluation based on performance and teamwork.
ex.zh: 员工每年都会依据绩效和团队合作接受评估。

ex.en: A careful evaluation of the data revealed several flaws in the original study.
ex.zh: 对数据的仔细评估揭示了原研究的几处缺陷。

ex.en: The teacher's evaluation of each student includes both test scores and class participation.
ex.zh: 教师对每个学生的评价包括考试成绩和课堂参与度。

books.unit: 51 当你了解更多，会有更多选择；52 “选择”相关词汇

senses: v. 逐渐消失；(使)液汽化，(使)蒸发
evaporate.usage: 同义vanish,disappear;派生evaporation n.蒸发(过程、状态),脱水(法);消失,衰退；e（表示“出去”）+vapor（发音类似“外婆”）+ate（动词后缀）→他的外婆有老年痴呆，出去后走丢了，再也没回来→消失。；索引p408

ex.en: Heat until all the water has evaporated.
ex.zh: 加热直至水全部蒸发。

ex.en: The job security that the US economy once offered to high school graduates has largely evaporated.
ex.zh: 美国经济曾经提供给高中毕业生的工作保障很大程度上已经消失了。

ex.en: Public enthusiasm for the project evaporated once the true costs became known.
ex.zh: 一旦真实成本公之于众，公众对该项目的热情便烟消云散。

senses: n. (节日的)前夜,前夕;傍晚,黄昏

ex.en: On the eve of the election, opinion polls still showed the two candidates neck and neck.
ex.zh: 选举前夕，民意调查仍显示两位候选人不相上下。

senses: ad. 甚至，即使；甚至更，愈加，还；甚至可以说

ex.en: Even experienced drivers find this mountain road dangerous in bad weather.
ex.zh: 即使是经验丰富的司机也觉得这条山路在恶劣天气下很危险。

ex.en: The museum stays open on Friday evening to attract visitors who work during the day.
ex.zh: 博物馆在周五晚上延长开放，以吸引白天上班的参观者。

senses: n. [C] 发生的事情；比赛项目；公开活动

ex.en: The election was widely seen as the most significant political event of the decade.
ex.zh: 这次选举被普遍视为这十年中最重大的政治事件。

eventual.usage: event(事件)+-ual→事情最终发生→最终的；[族] eventually

ex.en: After years of setbacks, the eventual success of the vaccine trial surprised even its most optimistic supporters.
ex.zh: 历经数年挫折之后，疫苗试验的最终成功连最乐观的支持者也感到意外。

ex.en: After months of negotiation, the two sides eventually reached a trade agreement.
ex.zh: 经过数月谈判，双方最终达成了贸易协议。

ex.en: The illness weakened him, and he eventually had to give up full-time work.
ex.zh: 疾病使他身体虚弱，最终不得不放弃全职工作。

ex.en: If you keep practising, you will eventually speak English fluently.
ex.zh: 只要坚持练习，你最终能说一口流利的英语。

senses: ad. 从来；曾经；不断地；总是；始终
adv. 在任何时候;曾经;总是;究竟

ex.en: It was one of the largest engineering projects ever undertaken in the region.
ex.zh: 这是该地区有史以来实施的最大工程项目之一。

senses: adj. 永久的,永恒的,经久不变的
adj. 冗长的,持续过长的,重复太多的

ex.en: The novel explores the human desire for everlasting youth and the disappointments that follow it.
ex.zh: 这部小说探讨了人类对永葆青春的渴望以及随之而来的失望。

ex.en: Every participant in the study received a full medical examination beforehand.
ex.zh: 研究中的每一位参与者都提前接受了全面体检。

ex.en: Everybody in the village contributed something to the rebuilding of the school.
ex.zh: 村里每个人都为学校的重建出了一份力。

ex.en: Smartphones have become an everyday tool for communication, payment, and navigation.
ex.zh: 智能手机已成为日常用于交流、支付和导航的工具。

ex.en: Everyone agrees that housing prices in major cities have risen far too fast.
ex.zh: 人人都认为大城市的房价涨得太快了。

senses: pron. 每件事；一切；形势；最重要的东西

ex.en: The sudden power failure brought everything in the factory to a standstill.
ex.zh: 突然的停电使工厂里的一切都陷入了停顿。

senses: ad./pron./conj. 处处；到处；各个地方；所有地方

ex.en: After the storm, fallen branches were everywhere along the coastal road.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后，沿海公路上到处都是被吹断的树枝。

ex.en: There is no doubt that gardens evidence an irrepressible urge to create, express, fashion, and beautify.
ex.zh: 毫无疑问，花园表明了一种人们抑制不住的，想要去创造、表达、塑造和美化的冲动。

ex.en: Anecdotal evidence of this kind fits nicely with the idea that only certain special people can drive trends.
ex.zh: 这类轶事证据很好地印证了一个观点：只有某些特别的人才能推动潮流。

ex.en: The police gathered fresh evidence linking the suspect to the robbery.
ex.zh: 警方收集到了把嫌疑人同这起抢劫案联系起来的新证据。

evident.usage: e(=ex向外)+vid(看)+ent→在外面就能看到的→明显的；派生evidently；self-evident；辨析：用于描述显然的事实；索引p408

ex.en: This tendency in the natural sciences has long been evident in the social sciences too.
ex.zh: 自然科学中的这种趋势在社会科学中也一直很明显。

ex.en: It was evident from her early essays that she would become a fine writer.
ex.zh: 从她早期的文章可以明显看出，她将成为一名优秀的作家。

ex.en: The benefits of the reform are evident in the latest employment figures.
ex.zh: 改革的好处从最新的就业数据中显而易见。

ex.en: The experiment had evidently been poorly designed, since none of the results could be reproduced.
ex.zh: 这项实验显然设计不佳，因为没有一个结果能够被重复出来。

senses: adj. 邪恶的,罪恶的,道德败坏的;坏的;讨厌的
n. 邪恶,罪恶,罪行;祸害

ex.en: He sees money as the root of all evil.
ex.zh: 他将钱财看成是万恶之源。

ex.en: The novel portrays the struggle between good and evil in human nature.
ex.zh: 这部小说描绘了人性中善与恶的斗争。

ex.en: Poverty is regarded by many as an evil that society must confront.
ex.zh: 许多人认为贫困是社会必须应对的弊病。

ex.en: In the film, the evil scientist experiments on prisoners.
ex.zh: 影片中，邪恶的科学家用囚犯做实验。

senses: vt. 引起或唤起(感情、记忆等)
vt. 产生或引起(回应、反应等)

phrases.p: evoke a tradition of English landscape painting
phrases.m: 唤起英国地貌绘画的传统

evoke.usage: e-（出）+vok（喊）→喊出→唤起。近义：arouse vt. 唤起；派生evocation n.唤起；词根记忆: e(out, 出)+vok(call, 叫喊)+e→喊出→唤起；索引p408

ex.en: The old photograph evoked memories of her childhood in the countryside.
ex.zh: 这张老照片唤起了她对乡村童年的回忆。

ex.en: The composer used folk melodies to evoke a sense of national identity.
ex.zh: 作曲家运用民间旋律来唤起民族认同感。

ex.en: The minister's speech evoked a strong response from the audience.
ex.zh: 部长的演讲在听众中引起了强烈反响。

evolution.usage: evolve 的派生词；[族]evolve vi. 进化；n.进化；演变，发展；索引p408

ex.en: Darwin's theory of evolution changed the way people think about the natural world.
ex.zh: 达尔文的进化论改变了人们对自然世界的看法。

ex.en: The evolution of the smartphone over the past two decades has been remarkably rapid.
ex.zh: 过去二十年智能手机的演变非常迅速。

ex.en: Researchers studied the evolution of language by comparing ancient manuscripts.
ex.zh: 研究人员通过比较古代手稿来研究语言的演变。

ex.en: The evolutionary history of a species can often be reconstructed from fossil and genetic evidence.
ex.zh: 一个物种的演化史通常可以根据化石和基因证据重新构建。

senses: v. 使发展，使进化，演变
v. 逐渐演变；逐步发展；进化；演化
evolve.usage: e-（出）+volve（转）→转出来→演变。族：evolution n. 进化；演变。近义：develop v. 发展；v.进化；逐步发展，逐渐演变；e（向外）+volv（旋转）+e→向外不断地旋转，不断地发展→进化，逐步发展；索引p408

ex.en: The company has evolved into a major chemical manufacturer.
ex.zh: 这家公司已逐步发展成一家大型的化工厂。

ex.en: Some animals evolved the ability to survive in extremely cold environments.
ex.zh: 一些动物进化出了在极寒环境中生存的能力。

ex.en: Over time, their friendship evolved into a successful business partnership.
ex.zh: 随着时间推移，他们的友谊发展成了成功的商业伙伴关系。

senses: v. 使恶化;使加剧;使加重

ex.en: Cutting public transport services would only exacerbate traffic congestion in the city centre.
ex.zh: 削减公共交通服务只会加剧市中心的交通拥堵。

senses: adj. 确切的,正确的,精确的

ex.en: Scientists have yet to determine the exact cause of the mysterious disease.
ex.zh: 科学家尚未确定这种神秘疾病的确切病因。

senses: adv. 准确地；(要求得到更多信息)究竟，到底

ex.en: And if you do, what exactly should you say?
ex.zh: 如果你要说出来，那到底应该说什么？

senses: v. 夸张，夸大，对……言过其实
v. 夸张；夸大；言过其实
exaggerate.usage: ex-（出）+agger（堆）+ate→堆过头→夸大。近义：overstate vt. 夸大；[族]exaggeration n. 夸张；ex(超出)+agge(联想成age年龄)+rate(速度)→年龄大但跑得比别人快→夸张；真 exaggerate their product quality 夸大他们的产品质量；索

ex.en: Demand for the product has been greatly exaggerated.
ex.zh: 对这项产品的需求被过分夸大了。

ex.en: Don't exaggerate the difficulties; the task is not as hard as you imagine.
ex.zh: 不要夸大困难，这项任务没有你想象的那么难。

ex.en: Media reports tend to exaggerate the risks of new technologies to attract readers.
ex.zh: 媒体报道往往夸大新技术的风险以吸引读者。

ex.en: Calling the delay a disaster is an exaggeration, though it did cost the company dearly.
ex.zh: 把这次延误称作灾难是夸大其词，尽管它确实让公司付出了沉重代价。

ex.en: Students who sleep well before an exam tend to perform better than those who revise all night.
ex.zh: 考前睡得好的学生往往比通宵复习的学生考得更好。

ex.en: The final examination accounts for sixty per cent of the total marks awarded for the course.
ex.zh: 期末考试占该课程总成绩的百分之六十。

ex.en: A thorough examination of the painting revealed that it was a clever forgery rather than an original.
ex.zh: 对这幅画进行仔细检查后发现，它是一幅精巧的赝品而非真迹。

examine.usage: [近]inspect vt. 检查；辨:最普通的用词，表示粗略地查看，也可指仔细观察或调查以确定事物的性质、功能、特点等；索引p408

ex.en: The committee will examine the proposal before making a final decision.
ex.zh: 委员会将先审查该提案，再做最终决定。

ex.en: Researchers examined the effects of sleep deprivation on memory.
ex.zh: 研究人员考察了睡眠不足对记忆的影响。

ex.en: The doctor examined the patient carefully but found nothing seriously wrong.
ex.zh: 医生仔细检查了病人，但没有发现严重问题。

ex.en: The recovery of this city is often cited as an example of successful urban renewal.
ex.zh: 这座城市的复兴常被引为城市更新成功的范例。

senses: n. (对古物的)发掘,挖掘,发掘现场

ex.en: Typically, archaeologists survey and sample (make test excavations on) large areas of terrain to determine where excavation will yield useful information.
ex.zh: 通常，考古学家会进行较大范围的地质勘测和取样（即进行试验挖掘）从而确定在哪里的挖掘会带来有用的信息。

ex.en: The excavation of the ancient tomb took nearly three years to complete.
ex.zh: 对这座古墓的发掘花了近三年时间才完成。

ex.en: Funding for the excavation was cut short by the economic crisis.
ex.zh: 经济危机导致发掘经费被削减。

ex.en: Workers at the excavation site uncovered coins dating back two thousand years.
ex.zh: 发掘现场的工人们出土了两千年前的钱币。

senses: vt. 超过(数量)；超越(法律、命令等的)限制
exceed.usage: surpass 的近义词；ex-（out）+ ceed（走）→走出→超过；助记:ex(超出)+ceed(行)→超越而行→超过；v.超过，超出；超越；ex（往外）+ceed（走）→走出固定范围→超过；索引p408

ex.en: His achievements have exceeded expectations.
ex.zh: 他的成就出乎预料。

ex.en: It reported a net loss of $5.6 billion for fiscal 2016, the 10th straight year its expenses have exceeded revenue.
ex.zh: 该公司报告2016财年净亏损56亿美元，连续第十年支出超过收入。

ex.en: Drivers whose speed exceeds the limit by more than ten per cent will be fined heavily.
ex.zh: 超速超过限速百分之十以上的司机将被处以高额罚款。

exceedingly.usage: 辨析:exceedingly意为非常地、极度地;excessively意为过多地、过分地,常表示说话者对事情不大赞成

ex.en: The manuscript proved exceedingly valuable, revealing details unknown to earlier historians.
ex.zh: 这份手稿证明极为珍贵，揭示了早期历史学家所不知道的细节。

senses: v. 胜过过去,超过,优于

ex.en: Children given the freedom to explore their interests often excel in areas that formal schooling neglects.
ex.zh: 获得自由探索兴趣的儿童，往往能在正规学校教育忽视的领域中表现卓越。

excellent.usage: excel的形容词形式；记：ex-（加强意义）+cell（优于）+-ent（形容词后缀）→优于别人很多的→极好的

ex.en: The laboratory has an excellent reputation for its research on renewable energy.
ex.zh: 该实验室在可再生能源研究方面享有极高的声誉。

except.usage: except for除……之外（整体中的细节）；prep.除……外，不包括 conj.除了，只是 v.不包括，把……排除在外；索引p408

ex.en: Robert F. Kennedy once said that a country's GDP measures "everything except that which makes life worthwhile."
ex.zh: 罗伯特·F·肯尼迪曾经说过，一个国家的国内生产总值(GDP)可以衡量"一切，除了让生命更有价值的东西"。

ex.en: The museum is open daily except on Monday mornings.
ex.zh: 博物馆每天开放，周一上午除外。

ex.en: Nothing of substance was discussed except the schedule for the next meeting.
ex.zh: 除了下次会议的日程安排，没有讨论任何实质内容。

exception.usage: with the exception of...除……之外；词组without exception无例外地;助记:except(除外)+ion(名词后缀)→除外;派生exceptionable adj.可反对的；n.例外，除外；索引p408

ex.en: With a few exceptions, the songwriting is very good.
ex.zh: 除个别地方外，这首歌写得很好。

ex.en: But these sites are exceptions to the norm.
ex.zh: 但这些遗址都是例外，而非常规。

ex.en: Every rule has its exception, and this one is no different.
ex.zh: 每条规则都有例外，这条也不例外。

senses: adj. 例外的,异常的,不寻常
adj. 例外的，特别的；优异的，非凡的
exceptional.usage: 助记:exception(例外)+al(形容词后缀)→例外的;派生exceptionally adv.罕见地,特殊地；索引p408

ex.en: This deadline will be extended only in exceptional circumstances.
ex.zh: 只有在特殊情况下才会延长最后期限。

ex.en: And you don't have to be someone's boss to tell them they did an exceptional job on a particular project.
ex.zh: 你不必成为谁的老板才能告诉他们在某个项目上做得非常出色。

ex.en: She showed exceptional talent for mathematics at a very early age.
ex.zh: 她很小就展现出非凡的数学天赋。

ex.en: The region enjoyed exceptional economic growth throughout the 1990s.
ex.zh: 该地区在整个二十世纪九十年代实现了异常快速的经济增长。

senses: n. 一部小说、电影、乐曲等的节录,摘要
excerpt.usage: 助记:ex(外)+cerpt(cept拿)→把书里的内容拿到外面来→摘录,摘要

ex.en: The magazine published a brief excerpt from the novelist's forthcoming memoir about her childhood in rural Ireland.
ex.zh: 这家杂志刊登了这位小说家即将出版的回忆录中的一段节录，讲述她在爱尔兰乡村的童年。

senses: adj. 过量的,过多的,超额的
excess.usage: in excess of...超过……；助记:ex(以外,超出)+cess(行)→超出限度的行为→过度,超越;同义surplus,extra;反义deficient adj.不足的;派生excessive adj.过多的,过分的,极度的；ex（出去）+cess（走）→水一直倒会往外走，盈满则溢→过量；索引p408

ex.en: "Avoid excess" is the golden rule for a healthy life.
ex.zh: 健康生活的一条黄金定律就是“避免过度”。

ex.en: Americans, she finds, buy roughly 20 billion garments a year—about 64 items per person—and no matter how much they give away, this excess leads to waste.
ex.zh: 她发现，美国人一年大约要购置200亿件服装——平均每人约64件——无论他们会捐赠多少，这种过量(购买)还是会导致浪费。

ex.en: Excess sugar in the diet is closely linked to obesity and heart disease.
ex.zh: 饮食中过量的糖与肥胖和心脏病密切相关。

ex.en: They complained about the excessive noise coming from the upstairs flat.
ex.zh: 他们抱怨楼上发出的噪声太大。

ex.en: Excessive reliance on imported energy leaves the country exposed to price shocks.
ex.zh: 过度依赖进口能源使该国容易受到价格冲击的影响。

ex.en: Doctors link excessive screen time with rising childhood obesity.
ex.zh: 医生认为儿童肥胖率上升与屏幕使用时间过长有关。

excessively.usage: adv.过分地，过量地；极度；索引p408

ex.en: Children who spend excessively long hours in front of screens may suffer from poor sleep.
ex.zh: 在屏幕前花费时间过长的儿童可能受到睡眠不佳的困扰。

exchange.usage: in exchange for...作为交换；n.交换，互换 v.交换，互换；兑换，交 易；索引p408

ex.en: If we readjust our view of arguments—from a verbal fight or tennis game to a reasoned exchange through which we all gain mutual respect and understanding—then we change the very nature of what it means to "win" an argument.
ex.zh: 如果我们重新调整我们对争论的看法——从一场言语争吵或网球比赛，到一场理性的交流，通过这种交流，我们都能获得相互的尊重和理解——那么我们就会改变"赢得"一场争论的核心本质。

ex.en: The two universities signed an agreement to exchange students and researchers every year.
ex.zh: 两所大学签署了每年交换学生和研究人员的协议。

ex.en: There was a brief exchange of ideas between the speakers at the end of the conference.
ex.zh: 会议结束时，发言者之间进行了简短的意见交流。

senses: n. [sing.] 国库；金库；公共财源
n. (英国)财政部；公共财源(或国库、金库)
exchequer.usage: 串词记忆：exchequer(财政部)check(检查)cheque(支票)。；索引p408

ex.en: Falling tax revenues left the exchequer short of funds for public services.
ex.zh: 税收下降使国库缺少用于公共服务的资金。

ex.en: The discovery of a possible new planet excited astronomers around the world.
ex.zh: 一颗可能存在的新行星的发现使世界各地的天文学家兴奋不已。

excitement.usage: excite的名词形式；助记:excite(使激动)+ment(名词后缀)→激动

ex.en: Good TV shows cannot replace the excitement of a zoo visit as an intense, immersive and interactive experience.
ex.zh: 优秀的电视节目无法取代参观动物园带来的那种激动，那是一种强烈的、身临其境的、具有互动性的体验。

ex.en: The children could hardly hide their excitement about the coming holiday.
ex.zh: 孩子们几乎掩饰不住对即将到来的假期的兴奋。

ex.en: The announcement of the discovery caused great excitement in the scientific community.
ex.zh: 这一发现的宣布在科学界引起了极大兴奋。

ex.en: City life offers variety and excitement that small towns often lack.
ex.zh: 城市生活提供了小城镇往往缺乏的多样性和刺激。

senses: adj. 令人兴奋的,使人激动的
adj. 使人兴奋的，令人激动的

ex.en: The lab offers students an exciting opportunity to test their own ideas.
ex.zh: 实验室为学生提供了检验自己想法的绝佳机会。

ex.en: The film tells an exciting story about the race to the South Pole.
ex.zh: 这部电影讲述了争夺南极的惊险故事。

ex.en: It is an exciting time to work in the field of artificial intelligence.
ex.zh: 现在是从事人工智能工作的激动人心的时代。

exclaim.usage: 助记:ex(出去)+claim(喊叫)→呼喊；v.呼喊，惊叫；ex（往外）+claim（说，喊）→往外大声地说→呼喊，惊叫；索引p408

ex.en: She opened her eyes and exclaimed in delight at the scene.
ex.zh: 她睁开眼睛，看到这情景，高兴得大叫起来。

ex.en: "What a marvelous view!" he exclaimed as the train emerged from the tunnel.
ex.zh: "多么壮观的景色啊！"火车驶出隧道时他惊叹道。

ex.en: The witness exclaimed that she had never seen the accused before.
ex.zh: 证人惊呼她以前从未见过被告。

senses: vt. 拒绝，把……排除在外，排斥
v. 不包括；不放在考虑之列；防止……进入；阻止……参加；把……排斥在外
vt. 把…排斥在外；不包括；排除（…的可能性）
exclude.usage: [反]include vt. 包括；vt.不包括，把…排除在外；排 除；ex（表示“外，向外”）+clude（=close，关上）→从外面关上，阻挡在外→防止……进入；把……排斥在外；词根记忆：ex(out,外)+clud(close,关)+e→关在外面→把…排斥在外；索引p408

ex.en: They exclude those who have stopped looking for a job.
ex.zh: 他们排除了那些已经停止找工作的人。

ex.en: You are now not wanted; you are now excluded from the work environment that offers purpose and structure in your life.
ex.zh: 现在你是个不被需要的人，被排除在工作环境之外，而正是那份工作为你提供生活的目标和架构。

ex.en: The price excludes breakfast, which costs extra at the hotel.
ex.zh: 该价格不含早餐，早餐在酒店需额外付费。

ex.en: The exclusion of part-time workers from the pension scheme was widely condemned as unfair.
ex.zh: 将兼职工人排除在养老金计划之外的做法被普遍谴责为不公平。

senses: adj. 排斥(性)的,排除在外的

ex.en: Critics say the club's exclusionary membership rules reflect an outdated social attitude.
ex.zh: 批评者说，该俱乐部排他性的会员规则反映出一种过时的社会观念。

senses: ②除外的，排他的；③(商品、商店等)高档的，豪华的
n. 独家新闻，独家报道
exclusive.usage: be exclusive to...为……独有；adj.独有的，专用的；高档的； 排斥的 n.独家新闻，独家报道；词根记忆：ex(out,外)+clus(close,关)+ive(形容词后缀)→关在外面的→独有的；索引p408

ex.en: That ruling produced an explosion in business-method patent filings, initially by emerging Internet companies trying to stake out exclusive rights to specific types of online transactions.
ex.zh: 这一裁决使得商业方法专利申请案例激增，最初是新兴的互联网公司试图对特定类型的在线交易方法获得独家专利。

ex.en: The hotel offers exclusive access to a private beach for its guests.
ex.zh: 这家酒店为客人提供私人海滩的专属使用权。

ex.en: The reporter obtained exclusive information about the company's secret plan.
ex.zh: 这名记者获得了关于该公司秘密计划的独家消息。

ex.en: For decades the club admitted members exclusively by invitation, a practice that attracted growing criticism.
ex.zh: 几十年来，该俱乐部一直仅凭邀请吸纳会员，这一做法招致越来越多的批评。

excursion.usage: n.短途旅行，远足；涉猎；ex（出去）+cursion（发音类似开心）→出去开心一下→远足，短途旅行

ex.en: We decided to make an all-day excursion to the island.
ex.zh: 我们决定花一整天时间去那个岛上玩。

ex.en: The school organised an excursion to the natural history museum.
ex.zh: 学校组织了一次去自然历史博物馆的游览。

ex.en: The travel agency offers day excursions to several coastal villages.
ex.zh: 旅行社提供前往多个海滨村庄的一日游。

ex.en: A brief excursion into the mountains revealed a remarkable variety of wildlife.
ex.zh: 短短一次山间远足就见到了种类繁多的野生动物。

excuse.usage: excuse sb. for doing sth.原谅某人做某事；另:make one's excuses做出解释;excuse from使…免除责任等

ex.en: Heavy traffic is a common excuse for arriving late to morning meetings.
ex.zh: 交通拥堵是早晨开会迟到的一个常见借口。

senses: vt. (常用被动态)(尤指依法)处决,处死
vt. [律]执行(法令),使(法律文件)生效
v. 执行，实行；处死，处决

ex.en: A good plan is worthless unless it is executed properly.
ex.zh: 再好的计划，如果执行不当也毫无价值。

ex.en: The pilot executed a smooth landing despite the strong crosswind.
ex.zh: 尽管有强侧风，飞行员还是平稳地完成了着陆。

ex.en: The court's decision to execute the prisoner sparked international protest.
ex.zh: 法院处决这名囚犯的决定引发了国际抗议。

ex.en: The plan looked impressive on paper, but its execution proved far more difficult.
ex.zh: 这项计划在纸面上看似令人赞叹，但实施起来却困难得多。

senses: adj. 实行的,执行的,行政的
n. (总)经理,董事,高管,行政负责人
n. 主管，经理，领导层；行政部门
adj. 经理的；有执行权的
executive.usage: CEO=Chief Executive Officer；adj.行政的，有执行权的；高 档的 n.主管，经理；行政部门；拓展：Chief Executive Officer (CEO) 首席执行官。；词根:ex(表强调)+(s)ecut(follow跟随)+ive→跟随到底的→执行的→管理人员;另:senior exe

ex.en: The chief executive announced a new plan to cut costs and improve services.
ex.zh: 首席执行官宣布了一项削减成本和改善服务的新计划。

ex.en: She has ten years of executive experience in a leading technology company.
ex.zh: 她在一家领先的科技公司拥有十年的管理经验。

ex.en: Senior executives are responsible for making major decisions that shape the company's future.
ex.zh: 高级主管负责作出塑造公司未来的重大决策。

ex.en: As executor of the will, she was responsible for distributing the estate according to the writer's wishes.
ex.zh: 作为遗嘱执行人，她有责任按照立遗嘱人的意愿分配遗产。

senses: adj. 典范的;可作榜样的;(处罚)惩戒性的

ex.en: Her exemplary conduct during the crisis earned her the respect of colleagues and critics alike.
ex.zh: 她在危机中堪称典范的表现为她赢得了同事和批评者的共同尊重。

senses: v. 是……的典型（或典范、榜样）；举例说明；例证；例示
vt. 举例说明；是…的范例

phrases.p: exemplify the division of A and B

exemplify.usage: ex-（出）+em（拿）+pli+-fy（动词后缀）→拿出具体事物阐述→举例说明。近illustrate vt.说明；represent vt.成为典型；同义: illustrate, demonstrate, show；索引p408

ex.en: The author intends to exemplify people's intuitive response to social epidemics.
ex.zh: 作者旨在阐述人们对社会流行现象的直觉反应。

ex.en: Her career exemplifies the value of persistence in the face of repeated rejection.
ex.zh: 她的经历堪称在屡屡遭拒面前坚持不懈的典范。

ex.en: The chapter exemplifies how small firms adapt faster than large ones.
ex.zh: 这一章举例说明小公司如何比大公司适应得更快。

senses: n. 被免除(义务、责任)的人;免税人

phrases.m: 免除女性的陪审团职责

exempt.usage: ex-（出）+empt（拿）→把名字从名单中拿出，使其不用做某事→免除。族exemption n.免除；豁免；派生exemption n.免除;免税；词根记忆：ex(out,在外面)+empt(take,拿)→把责任拿出去→豁免。；索引p408

ex.en: Even then several states automatically exempted women from jury duty unless they personally asked to have their names included on the jury list.
ex.zh: 甚至在当时，仍有少数几个州自动免除了女性担任陪审员的权利，除非女性主动要求将自己的名字纳入陪审团成员名单中。

ex.en: Charitable organisations are exempt from most forms of taxation.
ex.zh: 慈善组织免缴大多数形式的税收。

ex.en: Students with disabilities may be exempted from certain admission requirements.
ex.zh: 残疾学生可以免除某些入学要求。

ex.en: Small firms with fewer than ten employees are exempt from the new rule.
ex.zh: 员工少于十人的小公司可豁免于新规定。

ex.en: Regular exercise is known to reduce the risk of heart disease and diabetes.
ex.zh: 众所周知，定期锻炼能降低患心脏病和糖尿病的风险。

senses: vt. 运用,行使,发挥;施加(压力等)
exert.usage: ex-（出）+ert（力量）→用出力量→施加。近义：apply vt. 施加；exert oneself努力；尽力；同义: use, employ, utilise；v.运用，施加；努力，尽力；辨：exert强调使用权力去影响别人，更加书面化；索引p408

ex.en: There's no doubt that our peer groups exert enormous influence on our behavior.
ex.zh: 毫无疑问，我们的同龄人群体对我们的行为产生了巨大的影响。

ex.en: Parents exert a strong influence on their children's eating habits.
ex.zh: 父母对孩子的饮食习惯有很大影响。

ex.en: The union exerted pressure on the government to raise the minimum wage.
ex.zh: 工会向政府施压，要求提高最低工资。

senses: v. 使筋疲力尽,使疲惫不堪
exhaust.usage: [族]exhausted a. 精疲力竭的；同义: consume, finish, drain; 反义: fill；索引p408

ex.en: They worked until exhausted, lived with few protections and died young.
ex.zh: 他们工作到筋疲力尽，生活几乎没有保障，年纪轻轻就命丧黄泉。

ex.en: More frequent wildfires have become a national concern because in 2015 they exhausted unprecedented management efforts.
ex.zh: 越加频发的野火已经引起全国性关注，因为在2015年因野火而耗费的管理工作量空前巨大。

ex.en: Car exhaust remains a major source of urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 汽车尾气仍是城市空气污染的一大来源。

senses: adj. 筋疲力尽的；耗尽的

ex.en: After the twelve-hour shift, the nurses were utterly exhausted but still in good spirits.
ex.zh: 经过十二小时的轮班，护士们筋疲力尽，但仍然情绪高昂。

ex.en: Caring for three young children while studying at night proved far more exhausting than she had imagined.
ex.zh: 照顾三个年幼的孩子同时夜里学习，比她想象的要令人疲惫得多。

ex.en: Doctors warned that constant overwork had brought her close to physical exhaustion.
ex.zh: 医生警告说，长期过度劳累已使她接近体力透支。

senses: n. 展览品，陈列品；物证，证据
v. 展出，展览；表现，显示
exhibit.usage: ex(向外)+hibit(持有；拿)→向外"展示"自己持有的东西→展出；词根记忆：ex(out,出)+hib(hold,举行)+it(它)→举行展出它的展览→展览；辨析：exhibit 指非常正式的展览、展出，一般用于画展；索引p408

ex.en: The new exhibit will tour a dozen US cities next year.
ex.zh: 这批新展品明年将在美国十几个城市巡回展出。

ex.en: Museums stopped exhibiting some of Gilardi's artworks to prevent them from further damage.
ex.zh: 博物馆停止展出吉拉迪的艺术作品以防止其进一步受损。

ex.en: The gallery will exhibit a rare collection of impressionist paintings this autumn.
ex.zh: 美术馆将于今秋展出一批罕见的印象派绘画藏品。

ex.en: Patients with the virus may exhibit no symptoms at all in the early stages.
ex.zh: 感染该病毒的患者早期可能完全没有症状。

exhibition.usage: [族]exhibit vt. 展出；exhibit 的派生词；索引p408

ex.en: The gallery will hold an exhibition of modern Chinese painting next month.
ex.zh: 美术馆下个月将举办一场中国现代绘画展。

ex.en: Admission to the exhibition is free for students with valid ID.
ex.zh: 持有效证件的学生可免费参观该展览。

ex.en: The trade exhibition attracted exhibitors from more than forty countries.
ex.zh: 这次商贸展览会吸引了来自四十多个国家的参展商。

senses: n. 长期离国或离家；流亡
exile.usage: ex（出去）+i（我）+le（了）→我被弄出去了，就是我被“流放，放逐”了。

ex.en: The writer spent years in exile after criticising the government.
ex.zh: 这位作家在批评政府后流亡多年。

ex.en: The defeated king was sent into exile on a distant island.
ex.zh: 战败的国王被流放到一座遥远的岛上。

ex.en: Many exiles returned home after the political situation improved.
ex.zh: 政治局势好转后，许多流亡者回到了家乡。

senses: vi. [不用于进行时]存在,实际上有
vi. (尤指在困境或贫困中)生活,生存
exist.usage: [族]existence n. 存在；adj.现存的，现行的；索引p408

ex.en: Why this similarity exists in smell genes is difficult to explain, for now.
ex.zh: 目前还很难解释为什么在嗅觉基因方面存在相似性。

ex.en: Few people realize that such ancient customs still exist in remote villages.
ex.zh: 很少有人意识到这样的古老习俗在偏远村庄仍然存在。

ex.en: Poverty and extreme wealth exist side by side in many big cities.
ex.zh: 在许多大城市，贫穷与巨富并存。

senses: n. 存在,生存,(尤指艰难或无聊的)生活(方式)
existence.usage: come into existence形成；产生；n.存在，实有；生存，生活，生 活方式；索引p408

ex.en: But we are now knowledgeable enough to reduce many of the risks that threatened the existence of earlier humans.
ex.zh: 但现在，我们掌握了足够的知识，能够降低其中许多曾对人类早期生存造成威胁的风险。

ex.en: Public concern about the existence of aliens has grown since the recent sightings.
ex.zh: 自最近出现目击事件以来，公众对外星人是否存在的关注有所增加。

ex.en: Many small bookshops are struggling for existence in the age of online shopping.
ex.zh: 在网购时代，许多小书店正艰难求存。

senses: adj. 有关存在的；存在主义的

ex.en: The loss of his lifelong job raised existential questions about the purpose and meaning of work.
ex.zh: 失去做了一辈子的工作，让他对工作的目的和意义产生了有关存在的疑问。

ex.en: In an emergency, passengers should leave the aircraft through the nearest exit.
ex.zh: 紧急情况下，乘客应从最近的出口撤离飞机。

ex.en: Consumers complain that delivery firms charge exorbitant fees for shipping goods to remote areas.
ex.zh: 消费者抱怨快递公司向偏远地区运送货物收取过高的费用。

senses: a. 来自异国的；奇异的；异国风味的
adj. 吸引人的,漂亮的;珍奇的,奇异的
n. 外来物,外来品种,外来语
adj. 异国情调的；奇异的
exotic.usage: exo（外面的）+tic（形容词后缀）→外面来的→异国情调的。

ex.en: The garden is full of exotic plants brought back from South America.
ex.zh: 花园里种满了从南美洲带回来的异国植物。

ex.en: The restaurant serves exotic dishes that most diners have never tasted before.
ex.zh: 这家餐馆供应大多数食客从未品尝过的异国风味菜肴。

ex.en: The demand for exotic pets threatens the survival of many wild species.
ex.zh: 对珍奇宠物的需求威胁着许多野生动物的生存。

senses: vt.&vi. 扩大，增加，增强（尺码、数量或重要性）
v. 扩大，扩展；增加，增强；详述
expand.usage: expand further 进一步增加；expand the popularity of... 增加……的受欢迎程度；[族] expansion n. 扩展；扩大（链P271）；[近] extend vt. 扩大；扩展（链P129）；[反]contract vi. 收缩；ex（表示"往外"）+pand（发音类似"胖的

ex.en: But in addition to those trusted coworkers, you should expand your horizons and find out about all the people around you.
ex.zh: 但除了那些信赖的同事，你还应拓宽范围，去了解你周围的每一个人。

ex.en: Growth, which rarely continues beyond the age of 20, demands calories and nutrients—notably, protein—to feed expanding tissues.
ex.zh: 长高需要热量和营养——尤其是蛋白质——来满足身体组织生长的需要，而人在20岁之后就很少会继续长高了。

ex.en: The supermarket chain plans to expand its business into smaller towns next year.
ex.zh: 这家连锁超市计划明年将业务扩展到更小的城镇。

expansion.usage: expand的名词形式；n.扩大，扩张；扩充；索引p408

ex.en: The rapid expansion of the city has put great pressure on public transport.
ex.zh: 城市的快速扩张给公共交通带来了巨大压力。

ex.en: The company's overseas expansion created thousands of new jobs last year.
ex.zh: 该公司的海外扩张去年创造了数千个新的就业岗位。

ex.en: Heat causes the expansion of metal, which engineers must allow for in bridge design.
ex.zh: 热会导致金属膨胀，工程师在桥梁设计中必须考虑到这一点。

ex.en: In the 1990s the university embarked on an expansive building programme funded largely by private donations.
ex.zh: 二十世纪九十年代，这所大学启动了一项大规模的扩建计划，资金主要来自私人捐赠。

phrases.p: expect a basic level of service

expect.usage: [族]expectation n. 期望；v.期待；预计；要求；索引p408

ex.en: Analysts expect house prices to rise more slowly next year.
ex.zh: 分析师预计明年房价上涨会放缓。

ex.en: Parents should not expect their children to follow exactly the same path.
ex.zh: 父母不应指望子女完全沿着自己走过的路走。

ex.en: The delay was longer than anyone had expected.
ex.zh: 延误的时间超出了所有人的预料。
